tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thob pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba las sprul pa'i sku spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan gyis rjes su bzung ba'i tshul gyi sarga bzhugs// rgya gar skad du/ shrī sam+pat+sa ra kān+tā ra a gra te rat+na nir+m+ma ṇa kā ya ā nan+da nā nan+da nā mi ka dharmā swa mi tsa ra ṇa yaṃ ban+de/ bod skad du/ dpal lo dgon pa'i spyan snga rin po che'i sprul sku kun dga'i mtshan can chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud do/ /chos tshul mi 'dra'i chu phran bye ba brgya/ /gang thugs zab yangs rgya mtshor kun 'khyil ba'i/ /rigs med chos kyi sbyin bdag che ba po/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad don kun grub des skyongs/ /zhes pa'i bstod yul dam par gyur pa sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub kyi drung du dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin nos pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar/ ༈ /tshe sbyin dpal mo sgrol dkar spyan bdun ma'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ de'i lha khrid rgyas pa rje ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas myong khrid du stsal te/ de dang 'brel ba'i yig cha'i lung thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar lo rgyus/ sgrol dkar gyi rgya gzhung ngag dbang grags pas mdzad pa/ 'di'i mtshan ma brtag lugs/ sgrub thabs che chung gsum/ paṇa chen lugs kyi sgrub thabs bum chog che chung rjes gnang gi yi ge rgyas bsdus tshan pa gsum/ sbyin sreg byed lugs/ zung 'jug gi khrid kyi yi ge rnying pa rgyas bsdus/ 'di'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga sdig pa zad par byed pa'i cho ga rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas bsdus/ bsnyen sgrub kyi yig chung / dbang bsdud kyi yig sna/ ngag gi byad bsrung 'grol/ nad gso ba'i cho ga bar chad zhi byed ltas ngan g.yang du len pa'i man ngag

sa tsha'i rnal 'byor/ skor ba byed thabs/ 'jigs pa brgyad kyi srung thabs/ mtshon srung / g.yul las rgyal byed/ lam srung / ce spyang gi srung ba/ jag 'ching / rang la sdang ba 'chings byed/ sgrol ma'i bris sku dang lugs sku bya ba'i thabs/ de'i rab gnas rgyas bsdus/ yang lam srung che chung / rten 'brel mngon sum du 'char ba'i man ngag srung ba bri sgom gyi man ngag char che ba srung thabs/ gdon gyi cho 'phrul sel thabs/ lha mo'i pra 'bebs/ shes rab blo 'phel/ sgrol ma'i 'pho ba che chung rnams snga rabs kyi yig cha kha 'thor gtsang pa blo bzang pas phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i lung rnams rdzogs par thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ spyan snga ba/ sle nag pa/ dge bshes sgre pa/ sgam po pa/ bsgom tshul ston pa/ shes rab byang chub/ rje mdo 'dzin pa/ 'bri khung gling pa/ dam chos gling pa/ chos kyi tshul khrims/ mnyam med lha lung pa/ grub chen thog gnas pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug byang chub bzang po/ rong ston gyi gdan sa pa dwags po bkra shis rnam rgyal/ spyan snga bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ bla ma bsod nams legs mchog paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa/ rje dpal ldan chos 'byor/ rgyal ba'i sras po spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang dwags po bkras rnam pa yan gong dang 'dra ba las/ de'i rjes su chos rje karma 'phrin las/ rje tshar chen/ rje mkhyen brtse ba/ rje bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal ba'i sras po kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang 'di'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rje btsun ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ gnam kha 'ub pa/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/

chos rje sa paṇa/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po sogs nas rim par brgyud pa dang / yang brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ thub dbang / rje btsun sgrol ma/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sle nag pa man gong du bshad pa dang 'dra/ yang brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī/ lha brag pa byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ grub mchog bsod nams dbang po/ rgyal ba'i sras po spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /tshe dbang nye brgyud 'chi med dpal ster du grags pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ snang ba mtha' yas/ tshe dpag med/ rta mgrin/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rje kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ rgyal ba'i sras po spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ 'phags pa lha/ zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon dze ta ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / paṇ+ḍi ta pu ṇ+ya shrī/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa/ rje btsun sku mched/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ e pa 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston/ byang sems rin chen mgon/ chos rje rgyal sras pa/ chos rje tshul khrims dpal ba/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog

ri pa dpal ldan grags pa/ mkhan chen grags pa rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen rin chen grags pa/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas bkra shis/ mkhan chen dbang phyug dpal bzang / mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na 'phags pa rin po che/ sgro mon can pa rin chen dpal bzang / byang sems rin chen mgon po man 'dra/ yang na sa paṇa/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje/ khro phu bsod nams seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ rgyal sras rin po che man 'dra/ ༈ /tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ slob dpon snying po zhi ba/ dze ta ri/ gho dhi bha dra/ sa ma ti bho ṭa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ 'chims brtson 'grus seng ge rgya zhang phug pa/ byams pa shes rab rin chen/ 'khon ston 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ byang sems rgyal ye/ bla ma grags dpal/ snur chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ yang brtse ba rin chen seng ge bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ mkhyen rab rje/ bsod nams mchog grub/ byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ rje mkhyen brtse ba/ bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /'di'i yig cha'i lung yang thob/ ༈ /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi phyogs su gtogs pa rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes snying po/ ye shes zhi ba/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ku su la che ba/ chung ba/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ go mi sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ snyags ldem bu ba/ spug thams cad mkhyen pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bya rin chen 'od/

blo chen/ yul glo bo pa mtshan dngos sangs rgyas sras/ bde ba can pa/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ ngor chen kun bzang / rgyal tshab kun dbang pa/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ chos kyi spyan ldan spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ kun dga' snying po/ pra dz+nyā wa li ta/ pra dz+nyā bo dhi/ mu ti ta ko shwa/ dharmā pā la/ dhi paṃ ka ra/ shrī dz+nyā na/ go mi spyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi ma 'od zer/ sras badz+ra sidhi/ snur byang chub 'od/ snur nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ snur ye shes rgyal mtshan/ snur chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ bla ma 'phags pa 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan grags/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rje kun dga' chos grags/ bla ma dam pa nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa lha so bdun gyi bdag nyid can klu sgrub lugs kyi dbang rigs gtad dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ar+ya de wa/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug a wa dhu ti pa/ ku sa li che ba/

ku sa li chung ba/ dpal mar me mdzad ye shes/ 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshul khrims 'bar/ bya yul ba chen po gzhon nu 'od/ mus smad pa/ phyar chen po/ dpal ldan gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ rgya ston shes rab 'od zer/ dmar ston bsod nams 'phel/ slob dpon grags 'bum/ rong smon ri ba mkhan chen sangs rgyas rin chen pa/ rin chen grags tshul ba/ kun mkhyen nam mkha' 'od zer ba/ dus zhabs pa chen po don grub kun dga'/ bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ rje btsun spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na dpal ldan blo gros nas/ sangs rgyas bsgom pa/ 'chims nam mkha' grags/ mkhas btsun bsod nams ye shes/ byang sems bsod grags pa/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ kun mkhyen nam 'od pa/ des chos rje don grub kun dga'/ yang ku sa li yan chad 'dra ba la/ jo bo chen po a ti sha yol chos dbang / dge bshes sgre pa/ rje lung pa/ shar gling pa/ pho ba lung pa/ snye mdo ba thams cad mkhyen pa/ snye mo ba kun dga' don grub/ ra ba grags pa shākya seng ge mkhan chen grags tshul ba/ kun mkhyen nam mkha' 'od zer/ chos rje dus zhabs pa don grub kun dga'/ bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang sa skya pa'i yab chos rdo rje phur pa'i smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang rnam par dag pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ 'khon ston klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ rdo rje gtsug tor/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong /

bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ mkhan po shes rab rdo rje/ mkhan po thugs rje shes rab/ sngags 'chang dharmā kirti/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po/ rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na chos rgyal 'phags pa yan gong bzhin las de nas/ lo mchog bag ston/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma de pa/ dpal tshul ba/ ngor chen kun bzang / paṇa chen grags rgyal/ mkhan chen legs 'byung / sa lo man 'dra/ ༈ /mnga' bdag nyang ral lugs kyi gu ru drag dmar gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mnga' bdag nyang ral pa/ mnga' bdag ras chung ba/ bla ma bzung ston rin chen/ gu ru dharmā rat+na/ rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol/ drin can sangs rgyas lhun dbang / sprul sku kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje/ bla ma dam pa legs pa dpal bzang / rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rje btsun sngags 'chang chen po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan ngag dbang kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rjes su/

spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ jo gdan mkhan chen shes rab rin chen/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan man 'dra/ ༈ /'jigs byed rwa lugs ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ di paṃ ka ra/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng / klog kya dbang grags/ ldong ston shes dpal/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ byang chub dpal bzang / shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rje lha mchog rje bud+dha singha/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na lha mchog seng ge nas/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal/ shar chen/ spyan snga rin po che man 'dra/ yang na lha mchog seng ge bud+dha singha/ shar chen/ spyan snga rin po che chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ bir+wa pa/ sau ma pu ri/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka ha ḍa kaṃ ka bi ra ḍi ba/ de bi ko dri/ ma ti gar+bha/ blo bzang snying po/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ dza gad hi ma/ niska laṅka de ba/ paṇa gos dkar/ ra wen+t+ra/ hi ma ya/ chag lo tsā/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal/ gshong lo tsā ba blo ldan/ bla ma lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bya sder ba byang chub rin chen/ rwa ga brag pa shākya seng ge

chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rje kun dga' dbang phyug rje dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ yang na/ sems dpa' chen po/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang sgrol ma bla med lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun sgrol ma/ nyi ma sbas pa/ tsan+d+ra gar+bha/ dze ta ri/ ngag dbang grags pa/ shad+dha ka ra warma/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ dā na shrī/ mañdzu shrī/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ ne tshe sbal ston/ rnal 'byor mngon pa ba/ slob dpon dar ma shes rab/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / chos rje dpal ldan don grub/ rje ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /'khor lo bde mchog dril bu pa brgyud pa bka' bab gnyis dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rus sbal zhabs/ 'bar 'dzin/ kar+ṇa pa/ gu n+ya pa/ ti lo pa/ na ro pa/ phaṃ mthing pa/

klog kya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇa/ bo dong rin po che/ khro phu ba/ yang brtse ba rin chen seng ge bu ston/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje btsun sangs rgyas seng ge yongs 'dzin nam mkha' dpal bzang / rje kun dga' bkris/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na ngor chen/ gu ge paṇa chen/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ bud+dha singha/ rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / rje kun dga' bkra shis/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan/ kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na bo dong rin po che'i gnas su 'gro mgon 'phags pa'am/ tshogs bsgom rin chen gang rung ngo / kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ dril bu pa/ dga' ba'i rdo rje/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ a bh+ya ka ra gup+ta/ de wa pur+ṇa/ kha che paṇa chen/ spyi bo lhas pa seng ge dpal/ zhang 'dre lung pa/ rin po che khro phu ba/ yang rtse ba/ bu ston/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na dril bu pa/ de wa pur+ṇa/ kha che paṇa chen man 'dra'o/ ༈ /bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dpa' bo spyan ras gzigs/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ grub chen sha ba ri dbang phyug slob dpon mai tri gup+ta/ rgya gar phyag na rdo rje/ 'grel byed ka ma la badz+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya se na/ lo tsā ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/

chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tshab chos kyi dbang phyug lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang / bla ma byang seng / rje btsun dam pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po/ gung ru sher bzang / kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge byas 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros/ mus chen nam mkha' dbang phyug rje stong ra ba kun dga' legs grub/ rje kun dga' chos grags/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rtog pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ kha che paṇa chen/ dā na shi la/ sa paṇa/ 'u yug pa kun bsod/ nyi thog pa kun smon/ yon tan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ gnyan lo/ sangs rgyas seng ge mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / grub mchog rdo rje'i mtshan can/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku pad+ma dbang chen/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ grub thob zla char/ chos rgyal brtson 'grus rdo rje/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ mkhan chen chos rgyal dpal bzang / kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge chos rje rin chen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla chen chos dpal bzang po/ byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/

mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ sngags 'chang rat+na bha dra/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ mi pham chos rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /gu ru thugs sgrub kyi byin rlabs thugs rje'i dbang lnga thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po he ru ka longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sprul sku phyag na rdo rje/ smug nag dbang gi mkha' 'gro tshangs pa'i rgyal po gdong bzhi/ lha dbang brgya byin/ klu rgyal 'jog po/ rgyal po dza/ shākya pra bha/ o rgyan rin po che/ bi ma la/ shrī la mañdzu/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ sna snam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ gter ston rig 'dzin chen po rgod ldem/ sras mchog rnam rgyal mgon po/ sngags 'chang rdo rje rnam gnyis/ mtshan ldan ngag dbang grags pa/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / chos rgyal bsod nams/ grub mchog chos skyong bsod nams/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rtsa ba'i bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /gu ru zhi ba zhes grags pa bla ma gsang 'dus chos dbang lugs kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs dang / las byang le brgyad ma'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal sras pad+ma dbang chen/ drin can sangs rgyas kun grol/ rtogs ldan dharma'i mtshan can/ sprul sku lha dbang grags ldan/ so ston grags pa seng ge so ston 'dus pa rtsal/ so ston 'jam dbyangs rab 'phel/ so ston kun dga' gzhon nu/ drin can kun dga' legs ldan tshul khrims/ rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang / bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/

spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /gur drag nyang lugs kyi gtor ma la brten pa'i dbang bzhi thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku drag po dmar chen/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ mnga' bdag chen po nyang nyi ma 'od zer/ sras nam mkha' dpal/ gzu ston dharmā rat+na/ gzu rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol/ sangs rgyas lhun grub dbang / sprul sku kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub rgyal mtshan chos rje/ brgyud 'dzin legs pa dpal bzang / sprul sku nyang ston chos dbang / snub chen rin chen dpal bzang / rje btsun 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje/ legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje/ mthu ldan dbang po'i rdo rje/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ rig 'dzin yul mo ba stobs ldan shul 'gro brtsegs/ bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ nyang nyi ma 'od zer/ sras nam mkha' dpal/ 'di nas bla ma kha cig ma rnyed/ gu ru thugs mchog rdo rje/ gshong chen mkhas btsun bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin bstan pa rnam rgyal/ bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul gyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas/ thugs rje chen po/ srong btsan sgam po/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ grub thob dngos grub/ mnga' bdag nyang ral/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ shākya bzang po/ lha rje dge ba 'bum/

lcam ye shes mchog chu sgom pa/ mtha' bzhi bya bral ba/ tshul chen bsod seng / bla ma bkra shis rgyal/ chu rags pa blo rgyam/ 'phags mchog nor bu bzang po/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ stas sga ba ngag dbang grags pa/ yig drug pa shes rab dpal 'byor/ rje kun dga' grol mchog bla ma chos skyong rgyal po/ kun mkhyen nam mkha' rdo rje/ rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang / bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na 'phags mchog nor bu bzang po la/ hor ka bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dpal ldan legs pa/ ka bcu pa/ byang chub dpal/ 'phags pa blo gros rin chen/ yig drug pa man 'dra'o/ ༈ /gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i lam gyi snying po rgyu dbang lam du byed pa slob dpon gyis zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ thog mar snang ba gsum gyi khrid dang / de nas lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med/ phyi nang gi bskyed rim/ rmi lam 'pho ba bar do sogs zhar byung gi man ngag yongs rdzogs/ dbang gong ma gsum dang bcas pa'i khrid yig rje tshar pa'i gsung la thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtshos zin bris mdzad pa'i yig cha so so'i lung khrid rgyas par nos nas/ gsung ngag slob bshad kyi brgyud pa thog mar smras te/ brgyud lugs gzhan rnams rnam grangs kyi tshul du brjod pa ni/ 'og min chen por zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje bdag med ma/ /sau ma pu rir 'khrungs pa'i bi ru pa/ /rgya gar shar phyogs su 'khrungs kā hā pa/ /ma ga dhar 'khrungs ḍā ma ru pa'i zhabs/ /wa ra ṇā sir 'khrungs pa'i gnyis spangs pa/ /'phags yul shar phyogs su 'khrungs rat+na shrī/ /bod yul mang mkhar du 'khrungs 'brog mi rje/

/mdog smad phyi 'brum du 'khrungs rje btsun se/ /gtsang gi sag thang gnas 'khrungs dgon pa ba/ /grom stod kha 'ur 'khrungs pa'i brtse ba che/ /gzims spyil dkar por 'khrungs pa'i bsod nams rtse/ /sgo rum mgon khang mdor 'khrungs grags pa'i zhabs/ /sgo rum tshogs khang phur 'khrungs paṇ+ḍi ta/ /stag sde rlung khung du 'khrungs 'phags pa'i mtshan/ ngam ring mtsho'i khris na yod/ /ra sa mtshal khung 'khrungs pa'i dkon mchog dpal/ /de nyid du 'khrungs rgyal ba brag phug pa/ /zha lu khang gsar du 'khrungs 'gro mgon rje/ /'bras khud sgang skyar 'khrungs pa'i dpal ldan pa/ /mdog gi sgo phur 'khrungs pa'i bud+dha shrī/ dbu se/ /sa skya'i byi khung sgor 'khrungs kun dga'i mtshan/ /mus stod gling skyar 'khrungs pa'i sems dpa' che/ /lcam mo g.yang grong du 'khrungs bdag chen rje/ /rdo ring smon mkhar gnas 'khrungs kun spangs pa/ /dmu gshong dga' ba'i tshal 'khrungs tshar chen rje/ /zang zang byang rgyud du 'khrungs klu sgrub mtshan/ /bar sbug sems 'byor gnas 'khrungs mkhan chen rje/ /mal gro be'u snar 'khrungs spyan snga ba/ /sa skya'i phun tshogs gling lha chen/ skyes bdag a nan+da/ la 'o/ /de ni lam 'bras slob bshad kyi bla ma brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa yin la/ brgyud lugs gzhan rnams rnam grangs kyi tshul du brjod pa ni/ yang na chos rje sa paṇa nas/ gtsang gi sgyer phur 'khrungs pa'i tshogs sgom pa/ dbu se/ mdog stod rje grong du 'khrungs bsod nams brtan/ dbu se/ /thang pa ru bzhir 'khrungs pa rat+na'i mtshan/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge /dpal ldan pa man gong dang 'dra/ yang na nyan chen pa nas/ ra sa mtshal khung 'khrungs pa'i brag phug pa/ /kha snga dgon gsar du 'khrungs ri khrod pa/ /dpal ldan pa man chad gong dang 'dra/ yang na rje sems dpa' chen po'i rjes su/ 'bom gyi la steng du 'khrungs kun mkhyen rje/

/mus stod gling skyar 'khrungs pa'i grub chen pa/ /sa skya'i bde ldan steng 'khrungs dkon mchog 'phel/ /mus kyi gling skyar 'khrungs pa'i sangs rin rje/ /rtse gdong gnas 'khrungs sa skya lo tsā ba/ /sa skyar 'khrungs pa'i dkon mchog lhun grub mtshan/ /rtse gdong phyogs 'khrungs sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /lha chen rtser 'khrungs grub mchog bsod nams dbang / /spyan snga chos rje man chad gong dang 'dra/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar dang / rje rdo ring pa'i rnam thar tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ rje tshar pa'i rnam thar lam yig rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung yang thob/ ༈ /brda don gsal ba'i khrid bdag chen blo gros pas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bi ru pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas grub pa/ bla ma kun bsod/ brag phug pa man 'dra/ ༈ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi chos bzhi las lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan brda don gsal ba dang 'dra/ de nas tshogs bsgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man 'dra'o/ ༈ /bir srung gi byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ brag phug pa yan gong dang 'dra/ de nas chos rje rnam gnyis/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man 'dra/ ༈ /lam sbas bshad kyi thugs rdo rje'i khrid bdag chen gyi yig cha'i nang bzhin dang / 'khrul 'khor/ grub chen bcu/ phra mo brgyad dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni bir bsrung dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /de'i 'khrul 'khor so gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ nyan chen pa/ snyag snying po rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan 'bum/ bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man 'dra'o/ ༈ /sbas bshad pho brang lnga 'phrul 'khor dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ nyan chen pa/ dkar brag pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man 'dra/ ༈ /yang lam zab dang bir bsrung gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/

dpal ldan tshul khrims pa yan gong dang 'dra ba las/ de nas grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ kun mkhyen/ yongs 'dzin/ sa lo/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam mgon bsod nams dbang po/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ bir+wa pa/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ skyo ston dri med/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ 'gro mgon bsod rgyal/ dpal tshul ba/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ kun mkhyen/ rje sangs rin/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na skyo ston dar ba ye shes/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man chad gong dang 'dra/ yang na/ rje btsun/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin no/ ༈ /tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs yan lag drug dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan chad lam 'bras dang 'dra ba'am/ yang na 'brog mi nas/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ sgyi chu ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ gzhon nu grub/ zhang byang chub shes rab/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ rje bud+dha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seng ge rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen bsod nams lhun grub/

spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na 'dren mchog rje sangs rgyas rin chen/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o/ ༈ /yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan bsrung dbang po rdo rje gur gyi mgon po'i snyan brgyud kyi chos skor zab mo thob pa la/ thog mar mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ paṇa grub dad byed go cha/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas mchog pa/ chos rje skyes mchog rgyal mtshan/ grub dbang bkra shis seng ge tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje byams pa rab brtan/ chos rje snying rje bzang po/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /de nas phyi'i srung 'khor la brten pa'i rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i khrid kyi rim pa bsnyen pa byed tshul dang bcas pa/ de'i nang sel gyi man ngag skor la sngags pa nang rgyas kyi man ngag don tshan gsum/ mal phur gyi gdams pa/ e ka dza ti la brten pa'i rims srung ba/ rmi ngan zlog pa'i zhal shes/ mgon po'i tshe sgrub dang bcas pa/ slar de'i rjes su nang gi brag rdzong ma drag po sngags rgod kyi gdams pa/ gsang ba'i brag rdzong ma sems nyid ye shes kyi rtsal 'don rnam rtog bzhi dang bdud bzhi tshar bcad de tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i thabs khyad par can rnams nyams khrid du nos nas/

de dag dang 'brel ba'i rgyab chos lung gi skor la/ mgon po me 'bar mar grags pa thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ de nyid kyi dkar chag bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i zhal gdams/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ lcam dral gyi rjes gnang gi yi ge mal los mdzad pa/ lcam dral gyi rjes gnang 'phags pas mdzad pa/ rjes gnang bla ma dam pas mdzad pa/ lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang yar klung pas mdzad pa/ rten gzhi'i lung 'brog mi lo tsā bas bsgyur pa'i rdo rje gur gyi rgyud nas phyung ba/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs slob dpon bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa/ bram zes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ba ri bas bsgyur pa/ gur mgon gter ma'i gzhung / nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs dreg pa zil gnon slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa/ gri gug lha lnga'i dkyil chog bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa lo chen rin bzang gis bsgyur pa/ nag po srog gi spu gri sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa blo gros grags kyis bsgyur pa/ pho rkyang gi sgrub thabs bod yig ma sa chen gyi slob ma paṇ+ye badz+ra gyis mdzad pa/ mahā kā la'i man ngag tshan pa gnyis/ las mthar phyin/ mgon po tshogs bdag ltar bsgrub pa sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ de'i las sbyor bram zes mdzad pa'i bsad las kyi man ngag bka' bsgo'i tshul du bsgrub pa'i lugs/ drag po'i las sbyor gsum gyi man ngag mo rkyang gi sgrub thabs gnyan phul chung bas mdzad pa/ mo rkyang gi man ngag mkha' 'gro ma dbang du bya ba/ lha mo'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta lo ka shrīs bsgyur pa/ lcam dral sbags sgrub kyi sgrub thabs 'phags pas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i lcam dral gyi gtor chog lha brgyad thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa bya thabs mal los mdzad pa/ bka' sdod kyi yi ge bla ma mal gyi dbon po blo gros seng ges mdzad pa/

lha brgyad kyi sgrub lugs bzhi'i rnam gzhag zhib tu bstan pa sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub 'od ldan dpal gyis mdzad pa/ lha brgyad kyi sgrub thabs zla ba phyed kyis rtsal chen rdzogs pa ldan ma kun dga' dpal gyis mdzad pa/ bsad las dang zor 'phangs kyi man ngag pu tra ming sring gi byin rlabs a gnyan dam pas mdzad pa/ yar klung pas mdzad pa'i rjes gnang rgyas bsdus gnyis zin bris su bkod pa/ pu tra'i sgrub thabs slob dpon pad+mas rdo rje gdan gyi ka ba nas bton pa/ pu tra ming sring gi sgrub thabs bsdus pa sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ a gnyan dam pas mdzad pa'i pu tra'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa dang / 'bring po lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ yang pu tra'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa dam pas mdzad pa/ pu tra'i mchod gtor dpal ldan tshul khrims pas mdzad pa/ de'i bstod pa las rnams kun byed ma/ dam pas mdzad pa/ gtor ma la brten nas dgra bgegs bsad pa sogs shin tu zab pa'i shog ril bdun dam pas mdzad pa/ chos skyong gi lder sku dang bris sku bzhengs thabs 'phags pas mdzad pa/ bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag tshigs bcad ma dam pas mdzad pa/ rten gtor gyi man ngag sa chen dang dam pas mdzad pa gnyis/ pho rkyang gi sgrub thabs las bzhi'i khyad par brag steng pas mdzad pa/ zab gtad kyi man ngag mal gyis sa chen la gnang ba/ mahā kā la'i bzlas lung bzhi'i man ngag sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ gsang ba'i man ngag ces bya ba nang gi sgo nas 'khu ldog spong ba gong mas mdzad pa/ chos skyong lcam dral gyi 'khor lo'i man ngag gsang ba mkha' 'gro go ldog pa'i man ngag nag po chen po'i bod rbad gsad gsum dril ba'i man ngag 'khor lo'i bca' thabs/ 'khor lo'i rab tu gnas pa'i man ngag dam shing la dbang bskur ba'i man ngag mgon po lcam dral du sgrub pa bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ dgra bo lha dang bral ba'i man ngag

mahā kā la'i theb bzlog mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog spangs pa'i man ngag las mjug mnan pa bsad pa las kyi 'khor lo mnan pa dngos gong mas mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i phur bu'i sgrub thabs rgya gzhung bram zes mdzad pa mal los bsgyur pa/ 'di 'od ldan dpal gyi sbags sgrub la dgos pa'i thun sgrub zer ba de yin nam/ mgon po lcam dral gyi sbyin sreg dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal gyis mdzad pa/ sbyin sreg gi yi ge bram zes mdzad pa/ phur bu'i sgrub pa sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ phur bu chen po la srin gzugs kyis bstod pa/ rang srung 'khor lo'i gdams pa rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ srung 'khor dkar shākya grags kyis mdzad pa/ ru mtshon 'dzugs thabs yar klung pas mdzad pa/ bran bdud kyi las tshogs mal gyis sa chen la gnang ba yar klung pas bris pa/ nag po chen po'i sgo nas gzhan gyi ngag mnan pa/ slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i chos skyong spyi'i dmod bskul/ mkhas pa yon tan khris mdzad pa'i drang srong dmod bskul/ pu tra ming sring gsum gyi bod pa'i tshigs sa chen gyi man ngag yar klung pas bris pa/ pu tra'i 'phrin las 'chol ba yar lung pa nas brgyud pa/ 'khon nag zas su bza' ba'i man ngag slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i gces bsdus mal los mdzad pa/ mgon po'i gzungs 'dzur/ gtor zor/ dmod bcol rnams bla ma gnyan gyis mdzad pa/ gtor chen pad+ma dbang phyug gis mdzad pa yar klung pa la brgyud pa/ lcam dral gyi gtor chen gyi gsol kha bya tshul yar klung pas mdzad pa/ mdos bskang rgyas pa bram zes mdzad pa/ mdos bskang spyan chen pos mdzad pa sogs dkar chag nang ltar tshang bar thob nas/ ༈ /yang gur gyi mgon po'i nang khrid dam gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa rgyas par stsal te/ de'i man ngag gi cha lag lus kyi rtsa 'khor so so la brten nas las bzhi bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa khyad par can zhal shes kyis brgyan pa dang /

yang srung 'khor brag rdzong ma'i man ngag gi nang tshan rnal 'byor ma'i sgos dgra myur du bsgral ba'i las sbyor zab khyad can dang / nang khrid kyi cha lag snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i dmigs yul zhag bdun la med par byed pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams zhib cing mtha' chod pa nos nas/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i lung gi skor la rje tshar chen gyis bsgrigs pa'i snyan rgyud po ti'i nang nas/ de nyid kyi dkar chag dam pas mdzad pa'i shog ril bcu/ brag rdzong ma'i khrid yig rdo ring pas mdzad pa/ kha skong po ti'i dkar chag brag rdzong ma'i mngon rtogs/ gtor bsngo rgyas 'bring gnyis/ brgyud 'debs rnam kun ma/ dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ mgon po'i chog bsgrigs/ ser ba bsrung 'bebs kyi man ngag dug gi rlung chen nag po/ gtor ma gsum gyi rnam bshad/ ru mtshon 'dzugs thabs/ gzungs 'dzugs thabs/ las mgon gyi bskang gso las bzhi lhun grub/ bstod bskul 'og min bde chen ma rnams tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i mdos bskang / rje btsun rdo ring pas mdzad pa'i ser ba srung ba'i man ngag tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i gtor bzlog gi cho ga dgra bgegs kyi stobs 'phrog rol pa/ nag po chen po'i char dbab pa'i man ngag gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i zab pa'i gnad kyi man ngag las/ phyi sgrub la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa'i yi ge tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i nang khrid rgyun gyi nyams len gsang ba yang gsang sems kyi gnad lnga la brten nas 'khu ldog spangs te bran ltar bkol ba'i man ngag gi yi ge las sbyor gyi sngon 'gro'i ling ga bri ba/ dgug gzhug kha sbyor dbye ba'i yi ge bsgrubs kyang rtag mi 'byung na dpog chog bya ba'i yi ge rigs sngags go ldog pa'i yi ge zab pa'i yang tig snying nang gi man ngag las/

nang rtsa gsum la brten pa'i yi ge gong mas mdzad pa/ de nyid cung zad rgyas su btang ba'i mgon po mthu med du mi 'gyur ba'i yi ge mgon po dang pu tra lcam sring la brten pa'i shin tu zab pa'i man ngag gi yi ge gsang rten lus la bcangs pa'i gnad kyi yi ge rnams dam pas mdzad pa/ bla ma'i zhal las byung ba'i man ngag gi tho yig bdag chen gyis mdzad pa/ rdo ring pas mdzad pa'i gsang khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i yi ge tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i snyan brgyud kyi rin chen lde mig bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung la yang dgon dpal ldan bkra shis pas zin bris byas pa'i sgrub yig chen mo/ bdag chen gyis mdzad pa'i lha brgyad kyi sgrub thabs gsang ba yid bzhin nor bu/ brag rdzong ma'i bsdus don/ mal 'og gsang rdzas kyi yi ge tshar chen gyis mdzad pa rnams thob cing / ༈ /yang tshar chen gyis bsgrigs pa'i kha skong po ti'i nang nas/ nag po chen po'i lo rgyus/ lha mo'i lo rgyus/ pu tra ming sring gsum gyi lo rgyus dam pas mdzad pa/ de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bskang gso chos nyid ma/ bram zes mdzad pa'i sngon tshe bde gshegs ma/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa gang thugs ma/ las mgon sgo ma dang bcas pa'i bstod pa mal los mdzad pa/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i gtum chen ma/ lha mo'i bskang gso bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i bstod pa nag po rngam pa ma/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i gur mgon gyi bskul/ yum chen gyi bstod pa kun tu bzang po ma/ lha mo'i bstod pa til dmar ma/ lha mo'i bshags pa 'gro don sku mchog ma/ bstod pa mi pham ma/ stag tshang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i chos skyong spyi'i bskang bshags/ 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi lnga mchod/ bdag chen mthu stobs pas mdzad pa'i mnga' gsol gyi yi ge rat+na kirti'i gtor sgrub kyi lag len gsal ba'i sgrol me rnams nos shing /

༈ /yang tshar chen gyis bsgrigs pa'i mgon pod gyi ljang pu ti'i phyed yan tsam thob pa'i khrid man ngag de dag phal che ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrad+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng / yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo blo gros grags/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ sga a gnyan dam pa/ bdag nyid chen po/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs chos kyi nyi ma/ rje btsun sgom rung ba kun legs/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje mkhyen brtse ba/ rje byams pa rab brtan/ rje snying rje bzang po/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje bod mkhar ba/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ des sa skya pa a nan+dan la'o/ /de ni nang khrid dang brag rdzong ma'i brgyud pa gtso che ba yin lags/ ༈ /me 'bar ma'i lung sogs kyi phyi sgrub phal che ba'i brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa nas/ yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che/ sga a gnyan dam pa/ phing nag rdo rje dpal/ khams pa bkra shis 'od zer/ bar sding ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ ༈ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po gri gug lha lnga snyan brgyud lugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/

a ni ga badz+ra/ pad+ma badz+ra/ in+t+ra bhu ti/ phun tshogs bde ba/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal sbyin/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ se mkhar chung ba/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun grags/ rong mi ye shes/ tre bo rdo rje grags/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ theg chen chos rgyal/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang / mnyam med dpal 'dzin bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /gri gug lha lnga/ lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis ma rnams kyi ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor chen por rgya gzhung lugs kyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa/ shad+dha ka ra/ lo chen/ brag steng pa/ mal lo tsā ba/ rje sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ bkras lung pa/ dge sding pa chen po/ sangs rgyas dpal/ rin chen gling pa/ dkar gshog pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ theg chen chos rgyal/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa/ mkhan chen khrom yon pa/ brag thog pa dpal 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ de la klu dbang gling pa kun dga' rgyal po dang / lcang lo can pa bsod nams mchog ldan gnyis kyis zhus/ de gnyis la rje tshe bkras pas zhus/ de nas tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po man 'dra/ ༈ /khyad par lha brgyad kyi dbang thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pas rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal la gnang /

de la rje tshe bkras pas gsan/ yang na 'phags pa rin po che/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen dol bu/ mkhan chen byang seng / theg chen pa man 'dra/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bag ston/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa man 'dra/ gri gug lha lnga/ lha bcu gnyis ma/ lha bcu bdun ma rnams kyi thun mong gi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje gdan pa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ bdag chen ngag pa/ tshar chen man 'dra/ yang na dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ chos rje nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug ye shes bzang po/ rgyal sras blo bzang dpal 'byor/ rin chen chos rgyal/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang tshar pa man 'dra/ yang lha bcu gnyis ma'i brgyud pa lugs gcig la/ shad+dha ka ra nas/ jo bo rje/ lo chen rin bzang / dge tshul pur+ṇa ṇa/ rgya lcags ri gong pa/ rdzing bu kha pa shākya grags/ span phug pa dar ma shākya/ yang ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ze ba don grub ye shes/ khams pa shākya rdo rje/ bar thang pa chos grags/ bla ma dar ma shākya/ slob dpon bsod nams dbang phyug gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa ta dbon chen mo/ lo tsā ba tshul khrims brtan pa/ byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa tshar pa chos rje man 'dra/ yang na bsod nams dbang phyug bla ma mchog ldan/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rin chen rdo rje/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge nam mkha' ye shes/ de gsum la theg chen chos rjes gsan/ des 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal man 'dra/ gri gug lha lnga'i dkyil chog bram zes mdzad pa paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / 'gos los bsgyur pa'i lung yang thob/ ༈ /mgon po lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/

mtha' rten sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang bzlas lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ slob dpon la li ta badz+ra/ nag po ro 'dzin/ gyi ljang dbu dkar ba/ khams pa tshar dgu ston pa/ grub ston bsod nams grags/ bla ma mon mig dmar ston/ bla ma zhang chung ba/ lang 'gro byang chub dar/ de la lce ston mdo sde seng ge dang / dpal chen skye med jo gdan gyis zhus/ de gnyis la gru ston shākya 'bum/ dge bshes dbugs/ bla ma dharma gzi brjid/ nyi thog pa kun dga' zla ba/ mdar mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba/ pha chos rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa man 'dra/ yang na grub ston shākya 'bum/ de la dkar gshong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / bdag po bsod nams yon tan pas gsan/ de gnyis la bla chen chos dpal bzang pos gsan/ lo tsā ba madz+nyu shrī dz+nyā na/ rje mus srad pa/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ rje klu dbang gling pa man 'dra'o/ ༈ /gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad sbags te sgrub pa thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang dang / lha mgon bcu gnyis ma'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa/ dad byed go cha/ lo chen rin bzang / brag steng ba/ mal lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo ring pa/ rje btsun sgo rum pa/ de gnyis la tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/

spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang lha brgyad thun mong ma yin pa'i brgyud pa rdzong lugs ni/ 'phags pa nas/ zhang pa/ na bza' pa/ bla ma dam pa/ gzungs pa/ dge bzang pa/ bla ma rin chen/ zur shākya dpal ba/ rje mus srad pa/ sgyi chu ba shes rab rin chen/ tshar chen man 'dra/ yang na brag phug pa nas/ brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sa skya bu ston dbang phyug dar/ theg chen chos rgyal/ rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang / mus srad pa man 'dra/ ༈ /gsang khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i gur mgon lha dgu'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ paṇa grub dad byed go cha/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas mchog pa/ chos rje skyes mchog rgyal mtshan/ grub dbang bkra shis seng ge tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje byams pa rab brtan/ chos rje snying rje bzang po/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na tshar chen/ rje mkhyen brtse ba/ rje bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan man 'dra'o/ ༈ /phyi'i las mkhan gcer bu zangs gri can dang / nang gi las mkhan ber nag zangs gri can gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

sa chen yan 'dra/ 'gos ston/ tshar sgang pa/ dge bshes mi g.yo ba/ shes bsgom bla ma dpal/ slob dpon shes rab bla ma/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa/ yar klung pa khu dbon/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gong dkar ba chos rje tshul khrims pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na sa paṇa/ mdo khams kyi rta dge bla ma/ slob dpon shes rab bla ma nas/ bdag chen rgya dkar ba/ mkhas pa'i dbang po rat+na shi la/ rje btsun sgo rum pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po man 'dra/ ༈ /ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po'i thun mong ba'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa paṇa yan 'dra la/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng bzang / yar klung pa khu dbon/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ gong dkar tshul khrims pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po man 'dra/ ༈ /bran bdud thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ grub chen/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ paṇa grub dad byed go cha/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rje sa paṇa/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin chen seng ge bzang po/ mkhas grub seng ge rgyal mtshan pa/ mkhan po bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/

rgya dkar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'bum phrag gsum pa byams pa chos kyi don grub/ chos rje tshul khrims pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ mi pham chos rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang ngor lugs kyi gur mgon lha bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shad+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bzhi thog pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bdag po grags pa rin chen/ bdag po blo gros dbang phyug sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ chos kyi rje dkon mchog grags pa/ shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / grub mchog rdo rje'i mtshan can/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /'di'i gtor ma ni zlum gtor dkar po rtse rgyan can/ pu tra la yang zlum gtor dkar po chung ngu gcig yin no/ /las mgon pu tra lcam sring gi rjes gnang zur bka' thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / 'phags pa klu sgrub/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dharmā pā la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags/

bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug stobs 'phrog nag po chen po tsa turmu kha'i chos skor thob pa'i tshul la/ thog mar sgrub dus kyi mgon po zhal khra can thun mong ba'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub/ ba ling ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ gnyan lo tsā ba/ kha 'ub pa/ sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ yar klung pa/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje rdo ring pa/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ rje bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na/ bla ma dam pa/ bdag chen kun dga' rin chen/ bzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun kun spangs chen po man 'dra/

༈ /de nas rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pas zung 'jug gi gdod ma'i mgon po sngon du byed pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo zhal bzhi pa'i gsang khrid zab mo nyams khrid du bskyangs pa nos nas/ de dang 'brel ba'i yig cha'i lung thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ rtsa ba'i yi ge tshigs bcad/ brgyud 'debs dang bcas pa tshar chen gyis mdzad pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/ kha che'i rin chen grags/ rin chen rdo rje/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo/ kha 'ub pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ bla ma dam pa/ sngags 'chang gzungs pa/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub dge ba rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sangs rgyas mchog pa/ mtshungs med skyes mchog rgyal mtshan/ lcags mo bkra shis seng ge tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po man 'dra/ ༈ /gzhan yang gnyan mgon chen po'i man ngag gi yi ge mang po'i lung thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ gnyan lo chen po'i tshe'i rig 'dzin grub pa'i zab chos bsrung bzlog bsad mnan tshe sgrub dang bcas pa'i shog ril/ sbas te 'dzam gling du ma grags pa'i shog ril/ zhi ba nor sgrub kyi shog ril/ nang tsit+ta la brten nas zhal dngos su blta ba'i shog ril/ phyi 'gab 'dre mnan pa'i shog ril/ nang gi mal 'og shog ril/ gsang ba rang srog rten gyi 'khor lo'i shog ril/ 'khor bsrung zhing mi 'khu mi ldog pa'i shog ril/ yum chen khros ma nag mo'i shog ril/ 'chi med tshe sgrub pa'i shog ril/ dgos 'dod nor sgrub pa'i shog ril/ rdzas dang srog 'khor la brten nas sku dngos su blta ba'i shog ril snying rgya can/ ltas ngan cho 'phrul dbab pa'i shog ril/ dgra srog myur du gcod pa srog rtsa rnon po'i shog ril/

dgra mkhar rmangs nas bsgyel ba nag po chen po mkhar bsgyel gyi shog ril/ ser ba dbab pa spu gri ngar ma'i shog ril/ zhing sel 'jug pa spu gri so 'debs kyi shog ril/ gcun thabs nyi zla can gyi shog ril/ gnad la dbab pa lha mo nag mo'i shog ril bka' rgya ma/ 'khu ldog byed na mnan pa'i shog ril/ las byed du ma 'dod na ar la gtad pa'i shog ril te shog ril nyer gcig dpal mgon gyi bsnyen sgrub/ rlung 'khor/ gtor chen/ mnan pa rnams kyi zhal shes kyi yig chung / sgrub pa'i gnad rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ sgrub pa rkang grangs kyi yi ge gtor len bya rog brtag pa/ 'khu ldog mi 'byung zhing las myur du sgrub pa'i yi ge rtsa ba dang / gnad 'bebs dang / las tshogs kyi 'khor lo yi ge 'khor lo dang ling rtse ling ga'i zhal shes rnams kyi yi ge 'khor lo'i bri thabs kyi yi ge 'khor lo'i sngags bcang gi yi ge 'khor lo'i sngags bkod tshul gyi yi ge las tshogs 'ga' gsungs pa'i 'khor lo'i man ngag gi yi ge zhal gdams snying gi dum bu/ spu gri so 'debs kyi gdams pa/ zhal gdams snying gi dum bu las rang srung phra mo yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i gdams pa/ zhal gdams snying gi dum bu las rten gyi yi ge zhal gdams snying gi dum bu las gtor ma bzhi'i zhal gdams/ zhal gdams snying gi dum bu las 'khor lo'i zhal gdams/ bram ze'i dmod pa'i srog mthu/ bka' sdod drang srong nag po'i pra dbab pa/ than 'gyed gnyan gyi mgo spu ma/ yum chen bzhi'i than 'gyed kyi man ngag spar spu'i man ngag lha dgu'i nor sgrub thun mong ma yin pa/ rdzas kyi sgo nas bsad pa'i sbyor ba/ rdo nag yid dmar gyi sgrub mthu/ khang ser nag po/ dgra bo zla ba gcig la bsad pa'i bram ze mdze pho nag po'i man ngag dgra bo klu la gtad pa gnyan gyi na ga stobs 'phrog mon pa nag po nor gsher gyi man ngag zangs khab dmar po'i bsad las/

sreg byed me'i sbyor ba/ gcun pa'i mthar thug sdig pa nag po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi las sbyor/ man ngag gnad brgyad ma sogs yig chung tshan pa bzhi/ gnyan los mdzad pa'i lo rgyus/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi khyad par gyi yi ge rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge nag po 'gro shes dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bsnyen pa'i man ngag mngon rtogs dmar chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi las khrid nag po 'gro shes gzungs pas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i sgrub khrid bsnyen pa'i go rim gyi yi ge yar klung pas mdzad pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi spog chog shi sa bstan pa dang bcas pa'i mngon rtogs gsal byed kyi zhal gdams mthar thug yar klung pas mdzad pa/ des mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i zhal gdams/ des mdzad pa'i zhal gdams/ des mdzad pa'i bsad las kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can du grags pa/ des mdzad pa'i 'khrul 'khor ltab cing sba ba sogs mnan pa'i man ngag sbas don gsal ba/ des mdzad pa'i dpal mgon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge sgrub thabs rta bdun rgyal po mdo stod pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa/ sri'u gso ba'i gdams pa/ bu 'tshol ba'i man ngag mngal srung ba'i gdams pa/ yang sri'u gso ba'i gdams pa/ sri'u med pa btsal ba/ lte ba sgyur ba/ yod pa gso ba rnams kyi gdams pa/ gdong bzhi pa'i thugs dam bskang pa'i man ngag gnyan gyis nye gnas dar ma seng ge la gnang ba/ bstod pa'i skor la klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ paṃ pad ma gnyan gyis mdzad pa/ gnam kha'u pas dpal mgon dngos su zhal gzigs dus mdzad pa/

mal lo tsā bas rmi lam du zhal gzigs dus mdzad pa/ rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ dharmā shrī bha dras mdzad pa/ mkhan chen gnas drug pas mdzad pa/ bya ban yon tan blo gros kyis mdzad pa/ bkra shis grub kyis mdzad pa/ yang des mdzad pa/ bzang po rgyal mtshan pas mdzad pa/ shrī mān bha dras mdzad pa/ yang bzang po'i mtha' can gyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa rnams so/ /bskul sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa zur shākya dpal gyis mdzad pa/ bla rdo'i man ngag tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ tsa turmu kha'i rgya gzhung paṇ+ḍi ta ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa/ zhal bzhi pa'i chos skor gyi dkar chag gsang khrid kyi brgyud 'debs/ tshe sgrub srung zlog dang bcas pa'i rgyun gyi nyams len/ de'i rgyud 'debs rnams tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ las bzhi'i so so'i yig chung gnyan los mdzad pa/ de'i gsal byed theg chen chos rgyal gyis mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge kha'u pas mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi yi ge sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs kyi mchan bshad ri sul gyi rnal 'byor mas mdzad pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi yi ge gnyan los u pa de sha sgrub dus kyi las khrigs kha'u pas mdzad pa/ gnyan los mdzad pa'i stobs chen shugs drag ma/ kha'u pas mdzad pa'i lha mchog ma dang / dur khrod gnas brgyad ma/ yar klung pas mdzad pa'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge rnams so/ ༈ /yang zhal bzhi pa bsnyen dus kyi mgon por grags pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rat+na kirti/ rat+na badz+ra/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/

mkhan chen seng ge rgyal mtshan/ yar klung pa khu dbon/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo ring pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /sgrub dus thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kha che rin chen rdo rje yan sngar bzhin/ de nas ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ gnyan lo/ kha'u pa man sngar bzhin no/ /yang na bla ma dam pa nas/ bzhi thog kun rin/ bzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ mtshungs med shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug grub mchog bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /bram ze sngags gtad thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dam pa yan sngar ltar/ de nas bzhi thog pa kun rin/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan man gong bzhin no/ ༈ /dpal mgon gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ tshar chen yan khrid kyi brgyud pa bzhin/ de nas rje bod mkhar ba/ spyan snga chos rgya mtsho/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ dpal mgon khyung zhal can gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mahā de wa/ paṇ+ḍi ta shī la singha/ a tsa ra gnyan chen dpal dbyangs/ ka kha ru pa gnyan lo/ glang pan ngag ro/ rtogs ldan mtsho dkar ba/

spyan snga bsod nams grags/ chos rje bsod nams grags/ chos rje bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ chos rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ gra thang pa shes rab zla ba/ rje btsun rdo ring pa/ grub mchog sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /dpal mgon gdong gnyan can gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kha che rin chen rdo rje yan dkyus bzhin/ de nas paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ gnyan lo/ kha'u pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge dharmā kirti/ blo bzang pa/ nya dbon pa/ bla ma lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba/ pha brag thog pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ thugs sras kun dga' rgyal po/ rje tshe bkras pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ dpal mgon brtsegs zhal can gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo/ kha'u pa/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ rong pa sga lo/ sras shes rab seng ge bla ma bsod nams lhun grub/ bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ bla ma dpal ldan legs dbang / chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ pha brag thog pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa man sngar bzhin no/

༈ /dpal mgon dkar po tshe 'phel/ ser po bsod nams sgrub pa/ dmar po dbang sdud/ sngon po bgegs 'joms te las bzhi'i mgon po so so'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma'i bar dkyus bzhin/ de nas gnyan lo/ kha'u pa/ bla ma sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge chos rje dharma kirti/ chos rje bla bzang ba/ nya dpon kun dga' dpal ba/ bla ma lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba/ pha brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po/ klu dbang gling pa kun dga' rgyal po/ rje tshe dbang bkra shis/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos rgya mtsho/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /gnad dbab kyi mgon po gshin rje gshed ltar sgrub pa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rat+na kirti/ rat+na badz+ra/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ mkhan chen seng ge rgyal mtshan/ yar klung pa khu dbon/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje btsun rdo ring pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/

༈ /dpal mgon bram nag bshan pa drug skor nag po dom mchong gi rjes gnang / las tshogs kyi yi ge rjes gnang gi yig lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / klu sgrub/ dzo gi ka ma ru pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal ldan/ brang mo che pa/ rje btsun re mda' ba/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa/ rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ rje btsun bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang sprul pa'i skyes mchog spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan de nyid kyi drung du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dbang gong ma dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa sa lugs ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ rdo rje snying po/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta/ dus zhabs che chung / mkhas pa dpe med mtsho/ sā dhu pu tra bi khya ta de wa/ dharmā ka ra dang / dharmā mi tra/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ rgyus pa gzhon seng / dol po ye shes mgon po/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin chen grub/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ ru pa ka bzhi pa/ slob dpon bsod grags pa/ zhwa lu lo chen/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ lo chen rat+na bha dra/ rje kun dga' grol mchog mkhan chen shes rab rin chen/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang / zla bzang / lha dbang gzi brjid can/ zla ba'i byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/

lha yi dbang ldan/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa tsi lu pa a tsar+ya/ pi to pa dang / dus zhabs pa gnyis/ mañdzu kirti/ sa man ta shrī/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng / sga lo/ shes seng / dpal ldan seng ge kun mkhyen bu ston/ gong gsum chos dpal/ dge 'dun bzang po/ dpal ldan legs pa/ nam mkha' tshul khrims/ bsod nams grags pa/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ rje rat+na bha dra/ rje kun dga' grol mchog mkhan chen shes rab rin chen/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na/ dpal legs don grub/ kun dga'/ thar pa bzang po/ lo chen man 'dra/ yang na/ chos kyi dpal ba/ bsod nams 'phel/ paṇa chen shes rin/ lo chen man 'dra/ yang na/ rong pa shes seng / kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od/ kun mkhyen bu ston man chad gong dang 'dra/ yang na rong pa sga lo/ dbus pa tshul khrims dar/ shar pa ye shes rin chen/ kun spangs chen po/ byang sems rgyal ye/ jo nang yon rgyam pa/ kun mkhyen dol bu/ ma ti paṇa chen/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ byang chub seng ge de gsum gyis rjes su bzung ba theg chen chos rgyal/ dpal legs pa man 'dra/ yang na shes seng / skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen dol bu man chad gong bzhin no/ /yang na/ jo nang phyogs rgyal/ dbon rgyal bzang / rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags bzang / zhang ston kun dga' dpal/ nam mkha' dpal bzang / shes rab bkra shis/ byams pa shāka 'od/ chos dar grags 'phel ba/ lo chen 'gyur med/ rje a wa dhu ti pa/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ zla bzang / lha dbang / gzi brjid can/ zlas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha yi dbang ldan/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags/

pad+ma dkar po/ bzang po/ rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen bzang / phyag dmar/ khyab 'jug sbas pa/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang po/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong / dpal skyong / dus zhabs gnyis/ zla mgon/ 'bro ston lo tsā dkon mchog bsrung / rnam brtsegs/ grub chen yu mo/ dharme shwa ra/ mkhas pa nam 'od/ grub thob se mo che/ ga ga na dh+wa dza/ 'jam gsar/ chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs rje/ byang sems rgyal ye/ jo nang yon rgyam pa/ kun mkhyen dol bu man chad gong dang 'dra/ yang na byang sems ye rgyal/ 'phags pa 'od/ 'dis chos sku 'od dang kun spangs pa gnyis la'ang gsan/ kun mkhyen bu ston man chad gong bzhin no/ /yang na/ 'jam gsar/ rong pa sga lo/ shes seng / 'phags 'od/ bu ston man chad 'dra/ 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ se mo che pa/ bo dong rin rtse pa/ stag sde seng rgyal/ gshong ston sku mched/ lo mchog dpal seng / bu ston man chad 'dra/ yang na lo mchog skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen dol bu man chad gong bzhin no/ /yang na rin brtse/ 'jim pa rin she ye shes rin chen/ kun spangs la sogs 'dra/ yang na rin she 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/ byang sems rgyal ye man gong bzhin no/ /de ltar brgyud pa thams cad kyi phyag len phyogs cig tu dril ba'i dbang rgyas par thob nas/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags bzang gis mdzad pa dang / dbang chog dang 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi mdor bsdus dang po'i 'grel pa lo chen 'gyur med kyis mdzad pa'i lung yang thos so/ /mdo rgyud thams cad kyi nges don gyi snying po zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid nges don gyi dbang dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa rwa lugs ni/ 'og min gnas su chos sku rdo rje 'chang / /chos dbyings chen por longs sku dus 'khor lo/

/dha n+ye ke ṭar sprul sku shākya thub/ /sham+bha la ru chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams/ /orbi pa ru tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bhaṃ ga la ru pi to ā tsar+ya/ /wa ren+t+ra ru dus zhabs chen po dang / /mañdzu de shar dus 'khor zhabs gnyis pa/ /rgya gar shar du mañdzu kirti'i zhabs/ /ye rang grong du man+ta shrī che/ /me tog ne'u ldan du rwa lo chos rab ra rdo rje grags kyi sras/ dang / /khu lung se khyir ye shes seng ge rwa/ de'i sras/ /khu lung chos shing dgon par 'bum seng ra/ de'i sras/ /dbon dmar dgon par rje btsun sga lo dang / gtsang rong dkar phug gi mi nyag rdo rje seng ge de'i sras ye shes rdo rje'i sras te dpal sga lo'i skye ba yin/ /sham 'bar gnas su shes rab seng ge'i zhabs/ de'i sras rong pa/ /dben gnas jo mtshor kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od/ /ri phug dgon par mkhan chen bu ston rje/ /gnas mchog der bzhugs rje btsun nam mkha'i mtshan/ sku zhang / /chos grags zhwa lur mkhas mchog tsan+d+ra shrī/ /bsam sding dgon par 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan rje/ ri phug /shar chen gnas su mkhyen rab chos kyi rje/ /gra thang chos sder lo chen chos skyong bzang / /dpal ldan sa skyar sa lo 'jam dbyangs che/ /sman lding gnas su lo chen rat+na'i mtshan/ /chos lung byang brtser 'jam mgon grol mchog zhabs/ /jo gdan tshogs su mkhan chen rin she ba/ /lo yi dgon par spyan snga kun dga'i mtshan/ /de las thob pa sngags 'chang a nan+da la'o/ /yang na chos rab lha rje dpal rgyal dang / /glo bo lo tsā dol po ye shes mgon/ /kun spangs chen po 'phags 'od man chad 'dra/ /yang na kun spangs byang sems rgyal ye dang / /mkhas btsun yon rgyam kun mkhyen dol po'i zhabs/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ /grub chen kun blo 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang / /zhwa lu lo chen man chad sngar dang 'dra/

/yang na sga lo man lung gu ru dang / pu n+ya shrī /shes seng 'phags 'od bu ston man chad 'dra/ /yang na man lung gu ru lo grags pa/ yar lung lo tsā ba kirti dh+wa dza/ /grub pa dpal bzang mkhas btsun yon rgyam pa/ /kun mkhyen dol po man chad gong dang 'dra/ ༈ /'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rgyal rigs ldan yan chad rwa lugs dang 'dra/ de nas/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du dus 'khor zhabs/ /tso ri pa ru dus 'khor zhabs gnyis pa/ /kha che'i grong du paṇa chen zla ba mgon/ /'phan yul grags su bsgom pa dkon mchog bsrung / /gnam la sgang du sgrom ston gnam la brtsegs/ /'o yug rgyal khab gnas su yu mo rje/ mi bskyod rdo rje mtshan dngos dad pa rgyal po/ /g.yas ru grod chung dgon par de'i sras/ chos dbang zhabs/ /khang gsar dpal gyi dgon par nam mkha' 'od/ /pho lung pa phug nags su se mo che/ chos dbang gi sras ga ga dh+wa dza/ /rkyang 'dur chos grwar 'jam gsar shes rab 'od/ /man ngag dge sding dgon par chos sku 'od/ /skyid phug bde ldan gnas su kun spangs che/ ak+ṣo bh+ya mtshan dngos thugs rje brtson 'grus/ /bde chen dgon par byang sems rgyal ye'i zhabs/ /jo mo nang du mkhas btsun yon rgyam pa/ mtshan dngos thugs rje rgyal mtshan/ /sku 'bum chen por kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ /mkhar chung dgon par phyogs las rnam rgyal che/ mtshan dngos chos kyi rgyal po/ /rtse chen chos grwar nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ /sho ma'i ri bor grub chen kun blo'i zhabs/ /brtse chen shar chen gnas su 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang / /gra thang chos grwar lo chen chos skyong bzang / /dpal ldan sa skyar 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan/ /rat+na bha dra man chad gong dang 'dra/ /yang na/ kun spangs rje/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ lce btsun pa sogs gong dang 'dra/ yang na 'jam gsar/ sga lo shes seng /

'phags 'od/ bu ston/ lce btsun pa sogs 'dra/ yang na/ se mo che ba/ rin rtse ba/ 'dzin pa rin she shar pa dus 'khor ba/ jo nang kun spangs pa sogs sngar dang 'dra/ yang na/ rin she 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ye man gong bzhin no/ ༈ /nye brgyud dpe med 'tsho nas brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen/ grub chen dpe med 'tsho/ grub thob dpal 'dzin/ sā dhu pu tra/ 'od byed lha/ chos 'byung zhi ba/ grub thob nyi ma dpal/ rin chen 'tsho dang / paṇa chen bi bhu ti/ yang na/ chos 'byung zhi ba/ grags pa'i lha/ paṇa chen chos kyi 'bangs/ bi bhu ti/ ko brag bsod rgyal/ g.yung phug pa rgyal dge lho pa chos ldan gsum kas rjes su bzung ba go lung gzhon nu dpal/ thar pa lo tsa/ kun mkhyen bu/ lce btsun nam mkha' man gong dang 'dra/ yang na/ bi bhu ti/ a mo gha/ dpyal pad+mo can pa'ang zer/ kun mkhyen chos 'od/ kun spangs chen po/ byang sems rgyal ye man ring brgyud bzhin/ yang na/ bi bhu ti/ mar ston g.yang 'bar/ rnal 'byor seng 'bum/ kun spangs sogs 'dra/ ༈ /sa skya pa chen pos sga lo la gsan pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ rigs ldan/ dus zhabs gnyis/ tsa mi/ sga lo/ bla ma sa chen/ rje btsun bsod rtse/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ rgyus pa gzhon seng / dol po ye shes mgon/ kun spangs chen po man 'dra/ yang na/ rigs ldan/ sprul pa'i dge slong bsod snyoms pa/ phyogs kyi bram ze/ dha ri ka pa/ dus zhabs che ba/ bho dhi bha dra/ tsa mi/ sga lo/ sa chen man 'dra/ ༈ /nye brgyud paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ rigs gsum mgon po/ dus zhabs gnyis/ nā ro pa/ dpal ldan 'jigs med grags/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dpyal chos bzang / dpyal a mo gha/ kun spangs pa/ byang sems rgyal ye/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ mkhan chen bu ston man 'dra/ yang na byang sems rgyal ye/

jo nang yon rgyam/ kun mkhyen dol po man sngar bzhin no/ /sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas kha che paṇa chen la gsan pa'i srog rtsol rdo rje'i snyan rgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ rigs gsum mgon po/ dus zhabs gnyis/ dpe med 'tsho/ 'jigs med grags/ 'byung gnas sbas/ rnam grags lha/ dad byed/ lha dbang / kha che paṇa chen/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ rgyus pa gzhon seng / dol po ye shes mgon/ kun spangs chen po/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ mkhan chen bu ston man 'dra/ yang na kun spangs/ byang sems rgyal ye/ mkhas btsun pa/ jo nang yon rgyam/ kun mkhyen pa man 'dra/ ༈ /shin tu nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / sha wa ri dbang phyug paṇa chen/ bi bhu ta/ ko brag pa/ go long gzhon dpal/ thar lo nyi ma/ kun mkhyen bu ston man 'dra/ yang na/ rdo rje 'chang / sha wa ri/ paṇa chen bi bhu ta/ chos sku 'od/ kun spangs zhang / byang sems khams pa/ yon rgyam pa/ kun mkhyen pa sogs sngar dang 'dra/ de ltar dngos su smos pa'i brgyud pa de thams cad dang / gzhan yang gyi jo/ tsa mi/ sga lo/ sa skya pa/ zhang tshal pa/ jo bo rje nas brgyud pa la sogs pa'i sbyor drug gi man ngag thams cad gcig tu dril nas ma tshang bar med par bkod pa kun mkhyen gnyis pa bu ston chos rje dang / chos kyi rgyal po phyogs las rnam rgyal bas mdzad pa'i thog mtha' bar dge'i khrid yig so so dang / jo nang phyogs las pas mdzad pa'i ngo sprod gsang don rab gsal/ zhwa lu mkhyen rab chos rjes mdzad pa'i sbyor drug nyams su len tshul gyi yi ge lo chen 'gyur med bde chen gyis mdzad pa'i sbyor drug gi khrid yig chen mo dang po'i sangs rgyas 'char ba/ chag lo chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dus 'khor chos 'byung chen mo dpag bsam gyi snye ma/ dus 'khor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gsar rnying mang po'i lung sogs thos shing / gong du smos pa'i brgyud pa de rnams kyang thog mar dge ba bi bhu ti nas brgyud pa dang /
