bar du dge ba paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa dang / tha mar dge ba chos rgyal rigs ldan sogs nas rim par brgyud pa gtso che ba yin gsungs/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel chen po gshong 'gyur la/ lo tsā ba blo gros rnam gnyis kyis bcos pa'i steng nas bshad bka' thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang gong rwa 'bro gnyis kyi dbang gi rtsa ba'i brgyud pa dang 'dra ba las/ kho bos thob pa 'di ni rigs ldan chen po nas/ shang ston kun dga' dpal ldan/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' dpal bzang / paṇa chen shes rab bkra shis/ rje btsun byams pa shāka 'od/ thugs sras chos dar grags 'phel/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen nas brgyud pa de/ gtso che ba'o/ /yang gong gi yig cha de dag lung gi brgyud pa lugs gzhan ni/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen yang phal cher sngar dang 'dra ba las/ lo chen 'gyur med bde chen gyi rjes su/ rje btsun a wa dhu ti pa/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /bu ston dang mkhyen rab chos rje'i yig cha de dag gi brgyud pa'i lugs gcig ni/ mkhyen rab rje rgyal mtshan rin chen/ don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling rje/ rin chen dbang phyug rin chen rgya mtsho/ bhik+ṣu ku sa li pa/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ bu ston/ bde chen pa chos kyi dpal/ rgyal ba dpal lags/ 'dus bzang pa/ thar pa'i mtshan can/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ paṇa chen pra dz+nyā maṅga laṃ/ 'di'i bar nas bla ma 'ga' zhig ma rnyed/ rje bsod nams rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /dus 'khor sdom chen gyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

bu ston nas/ bhu ṭa ba yon tan 'byung gnas/ chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags bzang man gong bzhin no/ ༈ /ye shes khyung khra'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen chen po/ 'ga' rong pa lha'i rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa brtson pa/ chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags bzang man sngar dang 'dra/ ༈ /rdo rje shugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / dus 'khor/ shākya thub pa/ chos rgyal so lnga/ dus zhabs che chung / zla ba mgon po/ sgro ston lo tsā ba/ lha rje bsgom pa/ sgro ston gnam lha brtsegs/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ sras mchog dharmā+e/ nam mkha' 'od zer/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam gsar shes 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku ba/ thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ye/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ nyang dbon kun dga' dpal/ grub chen kun blo/ dkon mchog bzang po/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po/ lo chen rat+na bha dra/ rje 'gyur med bde chen/ rje a wa dhu ti pa/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /grub thob man lung pa nas brgyud pa'i dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi khrid zhal shes dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rigs gsum mgon po/ man lung pa/ yar lung lo tsā ba/ snye mdo pa/ ka bcu pa/ hūm̐ chen rin po che/ sbas pa'i sangs rgyas hūm̐ rgyal ba/ 'chi med grub pa/ chos skyabs pa/ paṇa chen rin po che/ rat+na bha dra/ 'gyur med bde chen/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /grub thob u rgyan pa nas brgyud pa'i bsnyen sgrub zab mo nyams khrid du thob nas/ de dang 'brel ba'i rgyab chos lung gi chos sna'i rnam grangs la/ u rgyan pa'i gsung 'phros rnam thar ma/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang /

bsnyen sgrub kyi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig bsnyen sgrub kyi dngos gzhi'i khrid zla seng pas mdzad pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ grub thob u rgyan pa/ zla ba seng ge rtogs ldan grags seng pa/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ mkha' spyod dbang po/ bsod snyoms 'bum/ chos dpal ye shes/ bla ma rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga sprul pa'i sku/ kun mkhyen bla ma/ rat+na bha dra/ ting 'dzin rgyal po/ ka bcu pa rdo rje bzang po/ rje a wa dhu ti pa/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na rat+na bha dra/ 'gyur med bde chen/ rje a wa dhu ti pa man 'dra/ ༈ /tsha chung snyan brgyud du grags pa'i khrid zab mo phyag len dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub thob u rgyan pa/ rtogs ldan tsha chung ba/ las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can/ zla ba seng ge jo nang sgom chen pa/ bya btang ba gzhon nu ba/ mtshan ldan sprul pa'i yum chen/ ri khrod ma dpal ldan mtsho mo/ rtog ldan gu ru bsam 'grub/ dkon mchog bsam 'grub/ nam mkha' bsod nams dpal 'byor/ rat+na a nan+da bha ga mkhan chen shes rab rin chen/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na brgyud pa gzhan rnams u rgyan bsnyen sgrub dang 'dra ba las/ rje rat+na bha dra/ rje 'gyur med bde chen/ rje a wa dhu ti pa/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ zla 'od gzhon nu/ phag mo grub pa/ rgya mtsho'i mtshan can/ kun ldan pa/ lo tsā ba/ bsod nams dbang phyug yang rtse ba/ bu ston rin po che/

thugs sras lo tsā ba/ tsaṇ+ḍa shrī/ bsam lding pa/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ dbu rgyan rdzong pa/ rje rat+na bha dra/ 'gyur med bde chen/ rje a wa dhu tī pa/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /nā ro chos drug gi khrid zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ thar tsa ba/ stag lung pa bkra shis dpal/ sku yal can/ sangs rgyas yar byon/ bkra shis bla ma/ sangs rgyas dpal bzang / nam mkha' dpal/ rat+na gu ru/ rat+na ka ra/ bkra shis dpal brtsegs/ byang chub rgya mtsho/ bkra shis dpal 'od/ ngag dbang grags pa/ u rgyan rdzong pa/ rje rat+na bha dra/ rje 'gyur med bde chen/ rje a wa dhu ti pa/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /dzam bhi ri'i rlung khrid zab mo thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gho rak+ṣa pa/ dzaṃ bhi ra/ ma ṇi ka ṇa tha pa/ rje btsun mkhyen brtse/ 'od zer mtshan can/ grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po nas brgyud pa'i gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro nai gu ma/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/ rnam rgyal mgon po/ gong dkar ba byang chub dbang rgyal/ tshe dbang bkra shis/ dpal ldan grub/ rnam rgyal mtshan can/ kun dga' gzhan phan bzang po/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /grub chen nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i ro snyoms skor drug nyams khrid du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / te lo pa/ nā ro paṇa chen/ ti phu gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rgyal ba lo dang gsum pa/

grub thob gling chen ras pa/ 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgyal sras/ dbon sras dar ma seng ge chos rje gzhon nu seng ge byang sems nyi ma seng ge rgyal sras seng ge shes rab/ chos rje seng ge rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge spos skyabs pa seng ge rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros seng ge mnyam med mkhyen brtse rtogs ldan/ mkhas grub legs pa rin chen/ grub chen blo gros mchog ldan/ mtshungs med rgyal dbang chos rje/ ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi grags pa/ kun spangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rgyal sras ngag gi dbang phyug kun mkhyen ngag dbang nor bu/ dran mchog rin chen dpal bzang / drin can sangs rgyas ser 'od/ mkhas btsun bsod nams rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa'i zhi byed phyi ma'i skor thob pa la/ dpal ldan bla ma sum cu rtsa drug gi rnam thar/ kun dga'i zhus lan nyer lnga/ dam pa'i ding ri brgyad cu ma/ dam pa'i thugs kyi zhus lan/ dam pa'i skye ba drug pa'i rnam thar/ lam lnga/ lam gsum/ lam gcig rnams kyi khrid zab mo nyams khrid du bskyangs nas/ rgyab chos kyi lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub dbang / 'jam dpal smra seng / pha dam pa yab sras/ pa tshab tan nes/ zhig po nyin seng / 'khrul zhig dar seng / rje gnyan mdo pa yab sras/ dpal chen/ kun mkhyen lhun pa/ chos rgyal shes rab bzang po/ rje rong ston/ gung ru/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje spyang lugs pa/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi ma/ gong dkar ba rin po che kun dga' dpal bzang / chu bo ri pa bstan 'dzin kun dga' bsod nams/ sprul pa'i sku lo nas spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/

༈ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ mtshan mo rgyu ba/ mtshan ma gyen bsgrengs rnams kyi khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ grub chen a mo gha badz+ra/ don yod rdo rje/ skyo ston 'od 'byung / skyo ston sku mched/ jo sras khams pa/ gnyan ston rin chen bstan pa/ de sras 'od bsrung / gnyan ston chos rgyal/ 'dzin pa rin she 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston/ 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/ bla ma cha rgyan dbang rgyal/ klog kya bla ma grags chen pa/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen grags rgyal/ mkhan chen legs 'byung / rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rje a nan+das mdzad pa/ khrid kyi yi ge rje dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa thos so/ ༈ /rdo rje 'jigs byed rnal 'byor bzhi'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ grub chen la li ta/ a mo gha/ ye shes 'byung gnas/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng ge rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ mkhan chen dang ma ba/ mkhan chen shes rdor ba/ nyang stod ār+ya/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ rje dge ba rgyal mtshan/ chos rje rin rnam/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge rje nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/

/khrid yig lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrīs mdzad pa thos so/ ༈ /thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid tshem bu lugs nyams khrid du mnos nas/ de'i khrid yig rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ tshem bu pa/ byang chub tshul khrims/ lha btsun dgon gsar ba/ kun spangs zhang / grags pa seng ge thogs med bzang po dpal/ gzhon tshul ba/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba phyag na/ bshes gnyen bzang po dpal/ nam mkha' tshul khrims/ ngag dbang lhun bkras/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bkra shis rnam rgyal/ mkhan chen kun legs pa dang / mkhan chen rnam sras bzang po dpal/ de gnyis ka la rin po che shes rab rin chen/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na grub chen tshem bu pa'i rjes su/ byang chub 'od/ brag dmar ba/ dgon gsar ba/ kun spangs pa/ byang sems rgyal ye/ gzhon seng pa/ 'phags pa bsod nams/ theg chen rin po che/ dpal ldan legs pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rje rdo ring pa/ rje kun dga' legs pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bdud kyi gcod yul zab mo nam mkha' sgo 'byed kyi byin rlabs dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa pho brgyud che ba ni/ bcom ldan shākya thub pa/ 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge bram ze ar+ya de wa/ rje dam pa sangs rgyas/ pho brgyud chung ba ni/ shākya thub pa/ byams mgon/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ ar+ya de wa/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ mo brgyud ni/ yum chen mo/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ su ka sid+dha/ dam pa sangs rgyas/ ye shes bla ma/ bsod nams bla ma/ ma cig lab sgron/ thod smyon bsam 'grub/

khu khom chos bzang / rgyal ba don grub/ rgya nag gcer bu/ dol pa zangs thal/ rgya sgo ri pa/ sangs rgyas ras sgom/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ lha ston zhig po/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / bsod nams brtan pa/ rdo rje bsod nams/ 'gro sgom nam dpal/ nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge paṇa chen dbang phyug grub pa/ tshul khrims bzang po/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ skal ldan rab dbyangs/ blo gros 'byung gnas/ chos 'od zer/ snying rje bzang po/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na dol pa zangs thal gyi rjes su/ sangs rgyas rab ston/ sangs rgyas dge slong / sum pa ral pa/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ bya bral chos rje rin tshul ba/ 'khrul zhig tshul rgyal/ mkhyen rab rin po che/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba/ rje nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /'ba' ra lugs kyi tshe khrid zab mo nyams khrid du mnos nas/ de dang 'brel ba'i yig cha'i rnam grangs la/ sngon 'gro thar pa'i sgo 'jug dngos gzhi rin chen gter mdzod/ zur 'debs ri khrod pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ zhal shes kyi gdams pa dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'od dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu gsang sngags kyi sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags/ mi la rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sgam po zla 'od gzhon nu/ khams pa rdo rje rgyal po/ skyu ra rin po che/ spyan snga rin po che/ chos rje yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin ldan/ chos rje zur phug pa/ chos rje 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po/ sangs rgyas seng ge

rin chen rgyal mtshan/ ye shes rin chen/ yon tan dpal 'byung / bsod nams shes rab/ grub chen kun mkhyen/ grub thob kun dga' bzang po/ sprul sku chen po/ rin chen snying rje bzang po/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /shangs pa bka' brgyud las 'ongs pa'i phyag chen ga'u ma myong khrid du mnos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / nai gu ma/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston pa/ chos rje ston pa/ gtsang ma shang ston/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs blo gros dpal bzang / 'jag chen kun dga' dpal bzang / rje bsod nams bzang po/ rje byams pa chos kyi nyi ma/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' chos grags/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /sa skya pa'i yab chos dmar mo skor gsum gyi nang tshan nā ro mkha' spyod sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig myong khrid rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi yig cha'i steng nas shin tu zhib pa lung dang bcas pa/ de'i lus dkyil gyi yig chung yid bzhin nor bu bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag zab mo gser chos ma/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang / mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ bde mchog yab yum thun mong ba dang / yum rkyang gi 'pho ba'i yig rnying / rdzogs rim zab mo rtsa dbu ma yum la sbyar ba'i khrid/ de nyid kyi de kho na nyid dngos su ston pa'i brda chos kyi byin rlabs khyad par can dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/

nā ro ta pa/ phaṃ mthing pa/ shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba/ bla chen sa skya pa/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ chos rje sa paṇa/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang ston chos rje/ rgyal ba brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan can/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje btsun mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rin po che bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rje snying rje bzang po/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma su ka sid+dhi'i chos drug yongs su rdzogs pa nyams khrid du mnos nas de'i yig cha zhwa lu mkhyen rab chos rjes mdzad pa lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / su ka ma/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog cog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston pa/ chos rje ston pa ste brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun dang / de nas shang ston pa/ rgyal mtshan 'bum/ 'jag chen byams pa dpal/ chos 'byung rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can/ shes rab bzang po/ don yod rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab yon tan dpal 'byung / zhig po bkra shis don grub/ byams pa chos kyi nyi ma/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ rje kun dga' chos grags/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /'phags yul grub pa'i slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje de nyid gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'gro ba'i don du sprul pa'i skur bsam bzhin du byon pa/ 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde de nyid kyis bstan pa'i khur chen po bzhes te/ dbang brgya/ khrid brgya/

mgon brgya sogs gsan pa rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa bstan pa'i mig rkyen la phan pa mdzad nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rgyun la dgongs te khrid brgya yongs rdzogs kyi rgyun mi nyams pa'i phyir/ de dag gi snying po bsdus pa'i khrid yig sngon 'gro dngos gzhi so so dang bcas pa dang / khrid brgya brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ khrid brgya'i mtshan tho/ khrid brgya'i lo rgyus/ khrid brgya'i spyi chings sogs gsung rab ngo mtshar can mang du mdzad pa de dag gi yig cha'i steng nas sa skya pa'i yab chos rnams nyams khrid dang / gzhan rnams lung khrid kyi tshul du yongs rdzogs mnos pa'i khrid kyi rnam grangs la/ khrid dang po zhen pa bzhi bral/ khrid gnyis pa theg chen blo sbyong / khrid gsum pa rten 'brel snying po/ khrid bzhi pa skyid sdug lam khyer/ khrid lnga pa sum pa lo tsā ba'i blo sbyong / khrid drug pa ma gcig gi don khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ khrid bdun pa snying po don gsum/ khrid brgyad pa sems nyid ngal gso/ khrid dgu pa bka' gdams skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim/ khrid bcu pa bstan rim chen mo/ khrid bcu gcig pa srid zhi mnyam nyid/ khrid bcu gnyis pa dbu ma chen mo/ khrid bcu gsum pa bka' gdams lkog khrid/ khrid bcu gcig pa bka' gdams lha bzhi'i thub pa'i khrid/ khrid bco lnga pa spyan ras gzigs snying rje mkha' khyab/ khrid bcu drug pa mi g.yo gtum po gegs srung / khrid bcu bdun pa sgrol ma mngon shes lung ston/ khrid bco brgyad pa po to ba'i dpe chos ngo sprod/ khrid bcu dgu pa bka' gdams thig le bcu drug khrid nyi shu pa sher phyin bka' bab drug pa/ khrid nyer gcig pa zhi byed lam lnga'i khrid/ khrid nyer gnyis pa bsgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum gyi khrid/ khrid nyer gsum pa byams chos lnga'i khrid/ khrid nyer bzhi pa dbu ma rang stong gi lta khrid/

khrid nyer lnga pa gzhan stong gi lta khrid/ khrid nyer drug pa sbas don gyi khrid/ khrid nyer bdun pa grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshe khrid/ khrid nyer brgyad pa sgrol dkar gyi tshe khrid/ khrid nyer dgu pa tshe dpag med dkar po'i khrid/ khrid sum cu pa smar khrid tshom bu lugs/ khrid so gcig pa smar khrid dpal mo lugs/ khrid so gnyis pa smar khrid zla rgyal lugs/ khrid so gsum pa skyer khang lugs kyi smar khrid/ khrid so bzhi pa bde mchog gi smar khrid/ khrid so lnga pa kyai rdo rje'i smar khrid/ khrid so drug pa phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi khrid/ khrid so bdun pa phyag rdor gtum po'i khrid/ khrid so brgyad pa phag mo kurma pā de'i khrid/ khrid so dgu pa ku ru kul+le'i khrid/ khrid bzhi bcu pa sbyor drug gi khrid/ khrid zhe gcig pa dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi khrid/ khrid zhe gnyis pa u rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid/ khrid zhe gsum pa lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid/ khrid zhe bzhi pa bsam mi khyab/ khrid zhe lnga pa pad+ma badz+ra kyi khrid/ khrid zhe drug pa ḍom+bhi pa'i lhan cig skyes grub/ khrid zhe bdun pa gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi khrid/ khrid zhe brgyad pa yon po srong ba'i khrid/ khrid zhe dgu pa phyag rgya'i lam khrid/ khrid lnga bcu pa mchod rten drung thob kyi khrid/ khrid nga gcig pa phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i khrid/ khrid nga gnyis pa mdo rgyud bsre ba/ khrid nga gsum pa bar chad gsum sel gyi phyi rol gdon gyi bar chad sel ba'i khrid/ khrid nga bzhi pa 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad sel ba/ khrid nga lnga pa ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad sel ba/ khrid nga drug pa phyag chen sdug bsngal gsum sel/ khrid nga bdun pa gnyug ma dran gsal gyi khrid/ khrid nga brgyad pa dag pa gsum gyi khrid/ khrid nga dgu pa rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa nyi shu rtsa dgu'i khrid/

khrid drug cu pa lam sbas bshad kyi khrid/ khrid re gcig pa brda don gsal ba'i khrid/ khrid re gnyis pa gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid/ khrid re gsum pa grol ba'i thig le'i khrid/ khrid re bzhi pa gshed dmar spros med kyi khrid/ khrid re lnga pa rnal 'byor bzhi rim kyi khrid/ khrid re drug pa 'jigs byed kyi rwa khrid/ khrid re bdun pa bde mchog yab la brten pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/ khrid re brgyad pa yum la brten pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/ khrid re dgu pa dril bu rim lnga'i khrid/ khrid bdun cu pa nag po rim bzhi'i khrid/ khrid don gcig pa bde mchog dkar po'i khrid/ khrid don gnyis pa gdan bzhi'i khrid/ khrid don gsum pa mahā ma ya'i khrid/ khrid don bzhi pa bde mchog bong zhal can gyi khrid/ khrid don lnga pa phag mo sgom drug gi khrid/ khrid don drug pa nā ro chos drug gi khrid/ khrid don bdun pa ne gu chos drug gi khrid/ khrid don brgyad pa phyag chen ga'u ma'i khrid/ khrid don dgu pa lam khyer rnam gsum gyi khrid/ khrid brgyad cu pa rang sems 'chi med kyi khrid/ khrid gya gcig pa su kha chos drug gi khrid/ khrid gya gnyis pa bdag med ma'i nang khrid/ khrid gya gsum pa lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid/ khrid gya bzhi pa phyag chen lnga ldan gyi khrid/ khrid gya lnga pa phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid/ khrid gya drug pa sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid/ khrid gya bdun pa rlung sems gnyis kyi khrid/ khrid gya brgyad pa rje mar pa'i sras mkhar ma'i khrid/ khrid gya dgu pa rngog pa'i bsre 'pho'i khrid/ khrid dgu bcu pa gnyan gyi shog ril bzhi'i khrid/ khrid go gcig pa ras chung snyan brgyud kyi khrid/ khrid go gnyis pa lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu'i khrid/ khrid go gsum pa zhang gi zab rgya'i khrid/ khrid go bzhi pa dpal chen sga lo'i sbyor drug gi khrid/

khrid go lnga pa phag gru zhal lung skor gyi khrid/ khrid go drug pa dgongs gcig gi khrid/ khrid go bdun pa stag lung chos drug gi khrid/ khrid go brgyad pa bla sgrub kyi khrid/ khrid go dgu pa lo ras thub pa lnga ldan gyi khrid/ khrid brgya pa yang dgon pa'i ri chos snying po drug khrid/ khrid brgya dang gcig pa mgon po sku rags ma'i khrid/ khrid brgya dang gnyis pa dpal gur gyi mgon po'i nang khrid/ khrid brgya dang gsum pa do ha skor gsum gyi khrid/ khrid brgya dang bzhi pa grub thob chos drug gi khrid/ khrid brgya dang lnga pa pad+ma lam rim gyi khrid/ khrid brgya dang drug pa rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi don khrid/ khrid brgya dang bdun pa nor bu mthong grol gyi khrid/ khrid brgya dang brgyad pa sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i khrid dang 'di skor gyi yig cha gong du bkod pa ltar gyi/ rje grol mchog zhabs kyis mdzad pa so so'i lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje grol mchog zhabs yan brgyud 'debs so so'i nang bzhin las/ de nas rje bstan 'dzin ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ rje rin po che lcags zam pa ngag dbang nyi ma/ gong dkar ba rin po che kun dga' dpal bzang / chu bo ri pa bstan 'dzin kun dga' bsod nams/ sprul pa'i sku lo nas spyan snga rin chen kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan de nyid kyi drung du/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi khrid thob pa las/ tog rtse pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rta mchog mda' can/ bī ṇa sa/ pi waṃ 'dzin/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu dhi/ phun tshogs zhabs/ grub pa'i sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ gun+dha ri pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ chos kyi ba/ bzang po'i zhabs/ rtog rtse pa/ bhu ṣa ṇa/ dha ma pa/ ka h+na/ dpa' bo rdo rje/

'brog mi/ se ston/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa chen/ bsod rtse/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal tshul/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ ngor chen kun bzang / mus chen dkon rgyal/ zhwa lu pa chos rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na ngor chen kun bzang / mkhas mchog dkon blo/ mkhas btsun dpal ldan rgyal po/ rje nam mkha'i mtshan can/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ ༈ /bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇa chen/ 'od shāka la ru pa ye shes mgon/ bag ston/ gzhon tshul/ tshul ba/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa man gong dang 'dra/ ༈ /phyag rgya chen po yi ge med kyi byin rlabs gdams ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ de wa a kar tsan+d+ra/ de gnyis ka la jo bo a mo gha badz+ra gyis gsan/ de la 'brog mis gsan/ bla ma se mkhar chung ba man gong dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /mchod rten drung thob kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ar+ya de wa/ dge slong nag po zhabs/ zla ba grags pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ma he'i dbu can/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man gong dang 'dra'o/ /gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs can/ dza lan+dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa/ shrī dha ra/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o/ ༈ /yon po bsrong pa'i brgyud pa yang de dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /in+d+ra bhu dhi'i lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ dang po/ dpal ldan sde yi zhal snga nas/ in+d+ra bhu dhi che ba/

/de bzhin du yang tshangs pa'i zhabs/ drang srong gzugs/ /bram ze mo rnal 'byor ma/ ni rdo rje grub/ /de nas shrī badz+ra ba dhi rgyal/ bar pa/ /de yi slob dpon de yi phyi ma ut+pal ma'i zhabs dang / /gos bral zhabs gcer bu/ dang de bzhin no/ /dpal ldan chung ba/ dz+nyā na bo dhi rgyal/ /de bzhin shrī yo bo dhi dang / /slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra dang / /ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i zhal snga de bzhin no/ /yan lag bar pa dpal ldan mo/ /bung ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ pad+ma de bzhin no/ /dur khrod du na ki lar bzhugs/ /lha lcam legs smin de bzhin no/ /bdag kyang dang po grub pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rdo rje 'chang / dpal bde ba chen po/ in+d+ra bhu ti/ dpal tshangs pa'i zhabs/ bram ze mo/ grub pa'i rdo rje/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu dhi bar pa/ slob dpon u pa ma'i zhabs/ slob dpon gos bral zhabs/ rgyal po dz+nyā na bo dhi/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka yan lag bar ma'i zhabs/ lha mo bung ba'i pad+ma/ lcam legs smin/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu dhi chung ba/ de'i slob ma bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ de la kha che shes rab gsang bas gsan/ de la 'brog mi ste de man 'dra'o/ /nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang / in+d+ra bhu dhi che ba/ lcam legs smin/ shes rab gsang ba/ 'brog mi man chad gong bzhin no/ /pad+ma badz+ra'i lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / bi la se badz+ra/ grub thob chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra bho dhi/ lcam legs smin/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ rje ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o/ ༈ /ḍom+bhi ba'i lhan cig skyes grub kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ḍom+bhi pa/ a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man sngar dang 'dra'o/

/lam skor brgyad kyi khrid yig sa skya pa gong mas mdzad pa rnams dang / bsam mi khyab kyi rgya gzhung / rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i mchan bu sa bcad dang bcas pa/ mar me'i rtse mo'i rgya gzhung / lhan cig skyes grub kyi rgya gzhung / bsam mi khyab kyi byin rlabs bya tshul 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos mdzad pa/ de'i lo rgyus/ lam skor dgu'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa rnams thos so/ ༈ /sa skya pa'i yab chos 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud bshad kyi dus su bstan pa'i rgyun mi nyams pa'i phyir/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis sbyar nas mdzad pa'i rin chen bzhi'i sngags btu dang / zhal bzhi pa'i sngags btu'i byin rlabs/ go cha'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo drug gi byin rlabs rnams rje bla ma mus pa chen po'i bka' bzhin don gnyer gzhan las ches che bar bgyis nas/ dus phyis thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri/ lū hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ gan+dha ra pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ kar+ṇa pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ bar ma'i slob dpon te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog kya ba/ mal lo/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun pa/ sa paṇa/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dge slong chen po/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ mkhan chen grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ chos rje dpal ldan rgyal po/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug zhe dgon pa chos rgyal mtshan/ sman gur ba rje bsod nams sangs rgyas/ bhak+ṣu paṇ+ḍe pa/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/

rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ chos rje dpal ldan rgyal po/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug man 'dra/ gter ston chen po pad+ma gling pas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru drag dmar gyi dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas de dang 'brel ba'i gter chos kyi lung thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ gu ru drag po'i lo rgyus/ gu ru drag po'i thugs dam bskang pa'i cho ga drag po gsum dril gyi bka' gtad byed lugs/ gu ru drag po'i them byang / gu ru'i lo rgyus chen mo/ 1 phyi sgrub yon tan kun 'byung / 2 nang sgrub yid bzhin nor bu/ 3 gsang sgrub reg chog spu gri/ 4 yang gsang rkyang sgrub rtsa ba/ 5 tshe dpag med kyi sgos sgrub/ 6 'jam dpal sku'i sgos sgrub/ 7 rta mgrin gsung gi sgos sgrub/ 8 phyag rdor thugs kyi sgos sgrub/ 9 mkha' 'gro sde lnga yon tan gyi sgos sgrub/ 10 'phrin las dbal gyi sgos sgrub/ 11 khyung gi sgos sgrub/ 12 sdig pa'i sgos bsgrub/ 13 dpa' bo rigs bzhi'i sgos sgrub/ 14 brda rtags gsal ba'i lde mig 15 dbang chog nor bu'i phreng ba/ 16 las byang me lce'i phreng ba/ 17 zhi ba'i sbyin sreg chen mo/ 18 rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg chen mo/ 19 dbang gi sbyin sreg chen mo/ 20 drag po'i sbyin sreg 21 me hom rab 'bar/ 22 chom rkun jag pa 'ching ba/ 23 rig ma 'gugs pa/ 24 srid pa rigs rgyud spel ba/ 25 phan bya srung ba'i 'khor lo/ 26 rgyal bsran bsrung thabs/ 27 ma thub shi sa bstan pa/ 28 sde brgyad spyi'i bsrung ba/ 29 rbod stong bzlog pa/ 30 dam sri rgyal bsran gsad pa/ 31 chung sri gso ba/ 32 mdze nad gso ba/ 33 chab gtor/ 34 byad gtong nad pa gso ba/ 35 drag po'i mtha' 'dul bya ba/ 36 chu 'khyags ser ba bsrung ba/ 37 char 'bebs/ 38 zas nor bsgrub pa/ 39 dgra bo klu la gtad pa/ 40 ser 'bebs thog gi bsad pa/ 41 tshe sgrub sngags kyi kun 'gebs/

42 dgra grogs mthun pa'i las mtha'/43 'di dpe ma rnyed nas lung ma thob/ zho chang bsrung thabs/ 44 bka' srung drag po gsum dril gyi gsol kha 45ste chos tshan zhe lnga pa 'di them rtsa ba'i yi ge dang / them med kyi yig chung gi skor la/ tshe dpag med kyi yig chung nas/ zho chang srung thabs yig chung bar dang / bka' srung drag po gsum dril gyi srog gi spu gri'i sgrub thabs rnams ni yig chung skor dang / yang yig skor la/ gu ru'i phyi sgrub kyi sgrub thabs/ yang yig snyan brgyud la/ nang sgrub kyi yang yig nyi zla ga'u/ khro bcu rgyan gyi bsrung ba'i yang yig theg chen zil gnon/ dpa' bo rigs bzhi dang 'brel ba'i gtor zlog char 'bebs yang yig 'gro don gsum pa/ drag po'i lung bstan gsal ba'i me long / bka' srung drag po gsum dril gyi yang yig cho 'phrul spre thod ma rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku spyan ras gzigs/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa/ gter ston chen po sna tshogs rang grol/ sngags 'chang tshe bdag rdo rje/ ngag gi dbang phyug nyi zla bzang po/ rje ngag dbang nyi ma/ bla ma kun dga' gzhan phan bzang po/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /thub pa'i dbang po gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje/ sems tsam rnam bden pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad kha ba/ se spyil phu ba/ sgan mo lhas pa chen po/ 'chim gro mo che pa/ 'chim nam mkha' grags/ 'chim blo bzang grags/ slob dpon sbas pa ston gzhon/ chos sku blo gros 'od/ mkhan chen seng ge rgyal mtshan/ byang sems chen po shākya bsod nams/ chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ rin chen dpal ldan chos 'byor/

spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /mgon po gri gug lcam dral gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / nag po chen po/ bram ze mchog sred/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ a wa dhu ti pa che chung / nā ro pa/ a ti sha 'brom ston/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ sprul sku bya yul pa/ gtsang pa rin po che/ rin chen glang lung pa/ 'dre sangs rgyas bsgom pa/ zom rin po che/ chos rgyal khams lung pa/ sangs rgyas jo bo/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ rin po che bcu bzhi pa/ rin po che tshes bcu pa/ rin po che rin chen 'phel/ rin po che tshul khrims dar/ rje bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams bkra shis/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na bya yul ba yan sngar ltar las/ sgyer sgom pa/ sangs rgyas dbon ston/ mkhan po ye shes 'bum/ mkhan po jo nag pa/ bla ma dharmā bkra shis/ bla ma smon lam rgyal mtshan/ rje kun dga' shes rab/ rin po che tshul khrims dar/ chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams lha'i dbang po man 'dra/ ༈ /zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul zhi ba phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / gsang ba'i bdag po/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan/ bai ro tsa na/ sprul sku gra pa mngon shes/ pu reng pa mgon po rin chen/ dge slong smon lam 'bar/ gung chung ston pa/ sha mi sgom chen/ dol pa badz+ra pa ṇi/ rgya byang chub sems dpa'/ brag dkar sman bla ba/ jo sras dkon mchog gzhon nu/ mgar btsun tshul ston/ mkhas grub chos dpal ba/ chos rje sangs rin/ 'gos gzhon nu'i mtshan can/ rje nam mkha' shes rab/ rig 'dzin chen po nyi zla 'od zer/ rje rnam rgyal dpal bzang /

chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /'di'i sgrub thabs gtor chog rjes gnang rnams kyi yi ge rnying ma'i lung yang thos/ ༈ /zhang blon gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje nyi zla 'od zer yan phyi sgrub dang 'dra ba las/ de nas chos rgyal dbang po'i sde/ rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/ kun dga' gzhan phan bzang po/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po'i rjes gnang dang / de'i sgrub thabs rgya gzhung klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dang / bod gzhung bcom ldan rig ral gyis mdzad pa dang / rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas klu'i dbang po/ klu sgrub/ dpal ldan a ti sha 'brom ston/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ zhang ston rdo rje 'od zer/ gro ston shes rab grags/ 'chim nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan ral gri/ dpal sding pa/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa dpal/ mnga' ris pa bla ma rgya gar/ rgyal mtshan/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ rong ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ 'di'i bar ma rnyed/ rje kun dga' chos grags/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /sman bla mched bdun gyi rjes gnang dang / sman bla'i mdo brgyad brgya pa/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa'i mdo chog dang bcas pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal/ bo dhi satwa che chung / rgyal po dge ba'i dpal/ jo bo rje/ lha btsun byang chub 'od/ zla rgyal/ dbang po lo tsā ba/ dgra bcom pa rgyal mtshan/ dbang mdzes/ yon tan dbang / bya yul ba dpal mdzes/ yon tan bzang po/ dbu mdzad ston yon/ mkhan chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang /

bla ma grags pa dpal/ byang sems bsod nams bzang po/ bla ma chos byang pa/ bla ma ma ti'i mtshan can/ chos rje bka' 'gyur ba/ chos rje bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ rin po che dpal ldan chos 'byor/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po/ 'jam dpal/ bo dhi sa twa chung ba/ rgyal po dge ba'i dpal/ a ti sha te se ba chen po/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ ong po lo tsā ba/ dgra bcom rgyal mtshan/ gya ba dbang mdzes/ yon tan dbang phyug bla ma jo gdan/ shangs pa 'dul 'dzin/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen ka bzhi pa/ rigs pa'i seng ge mkhan po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa grags pa seng ge bla ma blo bzang pa/ mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags man chad sngar dang 'dra/ ༈ /rje btsun dzam+bha la dkar po 'brug bzhon gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug jo bo rje a ti sha rgya brtson 'grus seng ge nag tsho lo tsā ba/ bshes gnyen ston pa/ dge bshes po to ba/ sha ra ba/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ spyan snga bsod nams 'phel/ ka bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge srib ri ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ lha phug pa rin chen 'od zer/ bla ma dpal ldan grub pa/ rin po che sangs rgyas 'od zer/ rin po che bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang dang / de'i las tshogs yongs rdzogs kyi yi ge nag po 'gro shes rdo rje 'dzin pa nam mkha'i mtshan can gyis mdzad pa'i lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

ye shes kyi mgon po nyid/ ra hu la gup+ta badz+ra/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog lcog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ sangs rgyas snyan ston/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ chos rje byams pa dpal/ chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ spyan snga rin chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas seng ge sangs rgyas rdo rje/ thar pa dpal bzang / sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje bod mkhar ba don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /dpal sa skya pa'i gser chos kyi nang tshan dmar chung ma skor gsum du grags pa las/ dpal mo snying gi gser thag can gyi rjes gnang / sgrub thabs/ las tshogs dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ gnyan lo/ gnam kha'u pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ khams pa rdo rje dpal/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ bla ma 'phags pa/ bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin chen dpal/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ pha chos rje/ yang na/ rje btsun chen po/ bla chen yar sgom/ rgyal tsha lung mang pa chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klung pa khu dbon/ pha chos rje brag thog pa bsod bzang / yang na/ sa paṇa/ tshogs bsgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ ka bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge gung pa bkra shis bzang po/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba/ pha chos rje brag thog pa bsod bzang / rdo rje gdan pa/ klu dbang gling pa/ rje tshe bkras pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /ku ru kul+le'i lo rgyus/ nyams su blang tshul sogs gnyan lo'i u pa de wa/

rjes gnang gi yig lung rnams thob/ ༈ /lha mo ti nu ma'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ku ru kul+le/ gnyan lo/ kha'u pa/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng bzang / yar klung pa khu dbon/ pha chos rje brag thog pa bsod bzang / rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal man gong bzhin/ ༈ /man ngag gces bsdus nas phyung ba'i sgrub thabs/ sgrub thabs dang lung 'bogs pa'i yi ge yar sgom gyi gsung / lung 'bogs thabs yar klung pas mdzad pa rnams thos/ ༈ /nor rgyun ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i rjes gnang / de'i sgrub thabs/ zhal shes rgyas bsdus gnyis/ rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni gong bzhin no/ /yang na 'di gsum char gyi brgyud pa ni/ pha chos rje brag thog pa bsod bzang / rdo rje gdan pa/ bla ma blo gros rnam rgyal/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug yab sras de gnyis la rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gsan/ des spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /ga ya dha ra nas brgyud pa'i sa skya pa'i dzam dmar srog sgrub kyi rjes gnang yi ge rnying ma'i lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a wa dhu ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ bla ma sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ yang sgom se bo/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung gi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar klung pa khu dbon/ mkhan chen nam mkha' lhun bzang / brag thog pa dpal 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/

bla ma blo gros rnam rgyal/ rje karma 'phrin las/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug yab sras gnyis ka la rje dbang phyug rab brtan gyis gsan/ des spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na yar klung pa'i rjes su/ bla ma bsod nams dang / dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ dpal kun bzang rtse pa/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ mkhas btsun rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub shākya 'od zer/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rje kun dga' chos grags/ nam mkha' chos dar man 'dra'o/ ༈ /grwa pa mngon shes can nas brgyud pa'i dzam dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang man ngag gi yig lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ dzam+bha la/ slob dpon pad+ma/ grwa pa mngon shes/ shes rab rgyal ba/ gzhung pa rgyan lags/ rong pa chos mgon/ dbang phyug grags/ gra dud pa/ mkhan po kun rin/ rin chen mchog pa/ dbu ma pa grub pa brtson 'grus/ ka bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge bla ma shākya grub/ rdo ston bsod nams bzang po/ rje rgyal ba dpal/ ya ma lag pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na/ grwa pa mngon shes/ lce ston gsal ba'i shes rab/ tshe don gsal/ dam pa shag po/ dam pa shes rdor/ bsod nams rin chen/ ka bcu pa gzhon seng man 'dra/ ༈ /'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze ta ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen/ rje btsun sga lo/ sras a ka ra/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge

bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na/ ngor chen/ mus chen/ kun mkhyen/ rje sangs rin pa/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na/ ngor chen kun bzang / paṇa chen grags rgyal/ mkhan chen legs 'byung / sa skya lo tsā/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra/ yang na ngor chen kun bzang / mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ mtshungs med ri khrod pa/ kun dga' mchog ldan/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o/ ༈ /dzam+bha la ser po dang nag po'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa'i dbang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze ta ri/ rdo rje gdan pa mched gnyis/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun/ tshogs bsgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ bsod nams skyabs/ gzungs kyi dpal ba/ bla ma dpal tshul/ shar chen/ rje rdo rje 'chang / kun dbang / 'dren mchog rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rta mgrin jo lugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ mar me mdzad/ yol grub thob/ mtha' bzhi grub thob/ rin po che smon lam/ rin po che lam pa/ lha ye shes 'od/ slob dpon legs pa shes rab/ byang chub rin chen/ byang chub gzhon nu/ mkhan chen byams rin/ mkhas btsun byang sems/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen grags rgyal/ mkhan chen legs 'byung /

rje lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /par+ṇa sha wa ri ser mo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze ta ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ chung ba/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ shar pa sku mched/ rin ye/ blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bsam gtan grub/ glo bo lo tsā ba shrī mam bo dhi/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen/ kun dbang pa/ 'dren mchog lha mchog seng ge bud+dha singha/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /yang na mus chen/ kun mkhyen/ 'dren mchog man gong dang 'dra/ phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad/ chos kyi rdo rje/ kun dga' bzang po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar ba 'phags pa shes rab/ g.yor po jo ston/ bcur bsod nams rin chen/ 'jim phu ba pad+ma bkra shis/ stag lha'i rje jo bzang / khro phu lo tsā ba chen po/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras rin chen rnam rgyal/ sku zhang nam mkha' mchog grub/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rje btsun rdo ring chen po/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/

mi pham chos rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rnam sras gser chen rta bdag brgyad kyi rjes gnang thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ zangs dkar yan gong bzhin/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ gtum mgon yon tan 'od/ lung khu bsgom pa/ mkhan po lung ston/ slob dpon legs pa'i shes rab/ bya sder pa byang chub rin chen/ bya sder ba byang chub gzhon nu/ mang mkhar ba blo bzang dkar mo/ mang mkhar ba blo bzang grags pa/ zangs ldan mkhan chen shākya blo gros/ 'bul dpon rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje 'chang sgom rum pa chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang / blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje btsun mai tri pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ mi pham chos rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /seng gdong ma lha dgu'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro bas/ de'i yig skor gyi lung thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i bdag bskyed/ yang de'i mdun bskyed bsgrub tshul/ yang seng gdong ma'i bskang gso/ rjes gnang bya tshul rnams legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang yab yum/ ḍā ki seng ge'i gdong can/ mnyam med u rgyan yab yum/ rtogs ldan sangs rgyas mgon po/ ras chen kun dar/ kun dga' bzang po/ byams pa chos nyi/ pad+ma gar dbang / grags pa 'od zer/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ ku sa li pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /shangs pa bka' brgyud lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / chos sku ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/

mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston thugs rje chen po/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shang ston/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya bral ri khrid ras chen/ shang dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang / grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya bsgom legs pa rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po/ rje ngag dbang nyi ma/ sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /grub thob brgyad cu'i rjes gnang sngon du 'gro bas/ de dang 'brel ba'i yig skor/ grub thob so so'i lo rgyus rnam thar dang / rjes gnang gi yi ge sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ grub thob kyi rtogs brjod/ de'i 'grel pa/ tshogs 'khor/ man ngag rin po'i che'i phreng ba rtsa 'grel/ sku bri thabs/ bstod pa/ chos 'di'i byung tshul/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba nas 'byung ba'i grub chen brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams kyi lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ mkha' 'gro ma ko ka li/ rma we waṃ gnyis/ de gnyis la sur+ya rasmi/ bram ze paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la/ grub thob tsha ba ri pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i dpal/ tsa mi lo tsā ba rin po che yab sras/ rat+na gu ru/ grub thob hūm̐ 'bar/ mkhas chen rgan lhas pa/ stag ston gzhon nu dar/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ mkhan chen gzhon nu mgon/ mkhan chen grags tshul ba/ rgya ma ba yon tan 'od/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bla ma ye shes rdo rje/ smug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/

des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /lha mo nam mkha'i gos can gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga rin po che/ rtogs ldan sding po ba/ gtsang po rin po che/ 'be sangs rgyas bsgom pa/ ze ba ston pa/ khams pa lung pa/ sangs rgyas jo bo/ bcu bzhi pa tshul khrims mgon po/ tshes bcu pa chos kyi rdo rje/ rgyal steng gser khang pa rin chen 'phel/ rin po che tshul khrims dar ba/ chos kyi rgyal po/ bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams bkra shis/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /klu gdon gyi gnyen po 'jam dpal na ga rak+ṣa'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ sha ri'i bu/ klu sgrub/ hūm̐ mdzad/ slob dpon pad+ma/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ snub rin po che/ chos rgyal rin chen gling pa/ dmar ston pa/ 'di'i bar du bla ma kha cig brtag zhig po gling pa sna tshogs rang grol/ shes rab rin chen/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /gza' bdud ra hu la'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku zhi khro rab 'byams/ sprul sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī singha/ dz+nyā na mi tra/ bi ma la mi tra/ u rgyan chen po/ nyang ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ ldang nga lhun rgyam/ seng ge dbang phyug mkhas pa nyi 'bum/ gu ru jo 'bar/ ku ma rā dza/ klong chen rab 'byams pa byams pa dpal/ kun bzang rtse pa/ ye shes dpal/ rnam rgyal mgon po/ rnam rgyal dpal bzang / sangs rgyas blo gros/ 'di na gcig yod de ma shes/

sbas pa'i rnal 'byor don grub rnam rgyal/ gong dkar ba/ kun dga' gzhan phan bzang po/ lcam zam pa/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rta mgrin jo lugs shwa na bzhi skor gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rta mgrin/ yum gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki sangs rgyas zhi ba/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ku sa li che chung / di paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na/ yol grub thob chos dbang / mtha' bzhi grub thob/ rin chen smon lam/ rin po che lam pa/ bla ma ye shes 'od/ slob dpon legs pa shes rab/ bla ma byang chub rin chen/ slob dpon byang chub gzhon nu/ mkhan chen byams pa rin chen/ mkhas btsun byang seng pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje bkra shis rnam rgyal/ bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ dge slong ma dpal gyi bzang po/ ye shes bzang po/ jo bo rje man 'dra/ ༈ rta mgrin grub rgyal lugs kyi rjes gnang dang / de'i yi ge rje tshar chen gyis mdzad pa lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin/ rig 'dzin dbang mo grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phu pa/ ras chung ba/ rje mi la ras pa/ dwags po lha rje/ mtha' rtsa ba/ 'bri khung ba/ spyan snga ba/ yang dgon pa/ spyan snga rin chen ldan/ zur phug pa/ rje 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po/ mkhas btsun rin chen rgyal mtshan/ rje bsod nams bzang po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje byams pa rab brtan/ mtshungs med chos 'od zer/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/

spyan snga rin po che chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ khro mo rme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ phyag na rdo rje/ khro mo ma/ seng ge'i gdong can/ gru spang rtsa ba rdo rje seng ge chos rje brag nag pa/ byang sems chen po/ bla ma dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams dar/ be bug pa bde legs rgyal mtshan/ rig 'dzin chos rgyal bsod nams/ rje btsun sngags 'chang chen po chos skyong bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shang ston chen po/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod thar pa'i rgyal mtshan/ drin can sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje bod mkhar ba don grub rgyal mtshan/ mi pham chos rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ / myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang dang / de'i yig cha rje tshar chen gyis mdzad pa lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ dpal sha ba ri dbang phyug mnga' bdag mai tri ba/ grub thob ra hu la gup+ta/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyen ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/

'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shang ston chen po/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum pa/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod thar pa dpal bzang / drin can sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ yang na/ tshar chen/ rje bod mkhar ba don grub rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos rgya mtsho/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /lha mo dud sol ma'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mkha' 'gro ma skal pa bzang po/ bir+wa pa/ nag po spyod pa/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ rje btsun mar pa lo tsā/ rngog chos kyi rdo rje/ bla ma mdo sde/ rgyal tsha ra mo/ slob dpon lcam me/ slob dpon kun dga' dbang phyug slob dpon rin chen rgyal po/ rin chen dpal/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' bzang po/ bsod nams don grub/ bsod nams lhun po/ rngog bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ rje bod mkhar ba byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ grub mchog rdo rje'i mtshan can/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi gtsug rgyan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa'i sa skya pa'i man ngag dmar po skor gsum du grags pa'i chos skor rnams thob pa la/ thog mar rje btsun ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ku ru kul+le/ rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa/ des rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'u yug pa kun bsod/ nyi thog pa kun smon/

yon tan dpal/ bu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dbang / 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar pa kun dga' bkra shis/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge shar pa man sngar dang 'dra/ ༈ /kag chol 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje gdan pa/ tha bi ra/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ lcags thang pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun/ chos rje pa/ khang bsod nams 'bum/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /tshogs bdag dmar chen gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje phag mo/ sa ra ha pa/ klu sgrub/ ri khrod mgon po/ haṃ ngu dkar po/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rong pa shes seng / bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang / byang seng pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po man gong dang 'dra'o/ ༈ /ye shes kyi mgon po beng chen dmar po'i rjes gnang / de'i yig cha rje mkhyen brtse bas mdzad pa lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / khar+sa pa ṇi/ grub chen mi tra dzo ki khro phu lo tsā ba/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/

sku zhang chos rje nam mkha'i mtshan can/ sku zhang nam mkha' 'bum/ mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ ka bzhi pa rin chen mchog grub dpal 'bar/ rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje btsun skal ldan bzang po/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang nas/ thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhar la 'byung ba dmar po skor gsum gyi man ngag las ku ru kul+le'i gsang sgrub ḍom+bhi lugs kyi byin rlabs de'i yig cha'i lung thob pa la/ rgya gzhung dang / byin rlabs bya tshul sa chen gyis mdzad pa dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje snying po/ ḍā ki ni su gha gi ḍom+bhi he ru ka tsa na ba/ te lo/ nā ro/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung / ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa paṇa/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bla ma kun bsod/ mnyam med chen po/ gzungs kyi dpal ba/ yar klung pa khu dbon/ pha chos rje brag thog pa bsod bzang / thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rnam rgyal/ bla ma blo gros rnam rgyal/ phrin las pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ stobs ldan 'od zer/ bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /tshogs bdag dmar chen phyag bcu gnyis pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang yar klung pa'i yi ge'i steng nas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas/ 'brog mi'i bar gsung ngag dang 'dra/ de nas 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa chen/ rje btsun rin po che/ yar bsgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/

mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng bzang / yar klung pa khu dbon/ 'jam dbyangs chen po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / rdo ring rin po che/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan man gong dang 'dra/ ༈ /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal mchog rdo rje chos/ yum bde ba rgyas byed ma/ dze ta ri/ la li ta badz+ra/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ rdo rje gdan pa/ thā gi ra/ ba ri lo tsā/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tshab lung gi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ de man tshogs bdag dang 'dra/ ༈ /ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang rgyas bsdus gnyis thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mgon po/ slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ar+ya de wa/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dus zhabs pa/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ dpal chen sga lo/ bde gshegs phag mo grub pa/ 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po/ skyi shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ skyi shod grags pa seng ge slob dpon sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ gnyan lo grags pa blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na lo chen ma ṇi ka shrī/ sprul sku rnam rgyal/ mkhas btsun nam rtse/ bla ma paṇ+ḍi ta man gong dang 'dra/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang gi yi ge gtor chog bskang gso/ mnga' gsol/ gtor ma la brten pa'i las tshogs/

bsrung bzlog gi yi ge rnams bla ma paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa/ rkang pa brgyad pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa lo chen chos skyong bzang pos bsgyur pa rnams thos so/ ༈ /chos skyong beg gdong lcam dral gyi rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / mahā de wa/ a tsar+ya nyi 'od grags pa/ sras zla ba nag po/ paṇ+ḍi ta dha ra tra shu/ mgar lo tsā ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa chen/ shud pu bkra shis 'od zer/ grub thob mdar char/ bo dong brtson 'grus rdo rje/ jo sras sangs rgyas rin chen/ shes rab mtsho/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug lcang spe ba seng ge 'bum/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge bzang po/ rnam grol rin chen bkra shis/ rtogs ldan yon tan mgon po/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu dpal/ mus sras pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ sgyi chu ba shes rab rin chen/ pha tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug grub mchog bsod nams chos 'phel/ rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /tshogs bdag dkar po'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ jo bo chen po/ dpal ldan dgon pa ba/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ sprul sku bya yul ba/ gtsang pa rin po che/ pha sangs rgyas bsgom pa/ zom rin po che/ khams pa lung pa/ sangs rgyas jo bo/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ sangs rgyas bsgom pa gsar ma/ rin po che bcu bzhi pa/ rin po che tshes bcu pa/ spyan snga grags she ba/ lo pa tshul dar/ rin po che bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ rgyal sras ngag dbang chos grags/ rje kun dga' chos grags/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /tshogs bdag dkar po'i las mkhan tshogs bdag spre'u'i gdong can gyi man ngag zab mo'i yi ge rnying ma zhal shes dang bcas pa dpe tshan gsum gyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang / spyan ras gzigs/ wa na ta bha dra/ ro gling pa/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug grub chen u rgyan pa/ be dge dbul nyid/ gzhon nu dbang phyug dpal 'byor grub/ lha rje rin chen/ bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog tshul khrims/ rin po che bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ 'di'i bar du bla ma brgyud pa 'ga' zhig btsal/ rgyal sras ngag dbang chos grags/ rje kun dga' chos grags/ bla ma nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i gdams pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyi thugs dam rje btsun sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang thob pa'i rim pa ni/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma/ sgrol ma myur zhing dpa' ba la brten nas bgegs dang 'tshe ba zhi ba/ sgrol ma dkar mo la brten nas gdon bgegs zhi ba/ sgrol ma ser mo la brten nas tshe dang longs spyod 'phel ba/ sgrol ma gser mdog can la brten nas tshe spel ba/ sgrol ma hūm̐ sgra sgrog pa la brten nas dbang du bya ba/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba la brten nas 'byung po 'dul ba/ gzhan 'joms ma la brten nas rbod gtong bzlog pa/ bdud dang dgra 'joms ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa/ dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya la brten nas 'jigs pa thams cad bsrung ba/ bdud dang bar gcod dbang du bsdud ma la brten nas bar gcod 'dul ba/ 'gugs shing phongs pa sel ba la brten nas nor bsgrub pa/ bkra shis thams cad sbyin ma la brten nas bkra shis spel ba/ sgrol ma me ltar 'bar ba la brten nas bar gcod bsrung ba/ khro gnyer can ma la brten nas bgegs la bsnun pa/ zhi ba chen mo la brten nas sdig pa sbyangs pa/ rig pa hūm̐ las sgrol ma la brten nas rtsod pa rgyal ba/ 'jig rten gsum g.yo ba la brten nas bdud zhi bar bya ba/

dug rnams rab tu 'joms ma la brten nas klu nad gso ba/ sdug bsngal sel ma la brten nas rtsod pa dang rmi lam ngan pa zhi ba/ rims bsrung ba la brten nas dal yams zhi ba/ rdzogs byed sgrol ma la brten nas 'phrin las thams cad grub pa rnams kyi rjes gnang dang / phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston pa/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad kha ba/ skyer sgang pa/ sangs rgyas dgon pa ba/ 'chim nam mkha' grags/ ze'u sku mched/ 'chim blo bzang grags/ gro nyen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen grub pa shes rab/ kun mkhyen rong ston chen po/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ brag dkar ba sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod nams dpal 'byor/ snub sgom sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug spyan snga chos rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi yi ge rnying pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ sgrol ma/ nag po pa/ wa khu paṇ+ḍi ta/ khu rnal 'byor pa/ zur khang pa gzhon dbang / dge slong bsod nams lhun grub/ lo mchog blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang pa/ spangs khang pa grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ snar thar pa kun rgyal/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs sher rgyam/ mkhas grub dpal rdor ba/ grub chen pu ṇ+ya singha/ rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ spyan snga chos rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ dwags po rin po che/ khams pa rdor rgyal/

'bri khung pa/ spyan snga ba/ yang dgon pa/ rin chen ldan/ zur phug pa/ 'ba' ra ba/ bde legs pa/ kun dga' dpal/ rgyal dbang rje/ ngag dbang chos rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs chos grags/ kun spangs shes rgyal/ pad+ma dkar po/ rje ngag dbang bzang po/ dpag bsam dbang po/ sprul sku ngag dbang rin chen bstan 'dzin dpal bzang po/ bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /phyag rdor khyung khra'i rjes gnang rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi lung dang bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang / rgyal po zla ba bzang po/ rgyal po grags pa/ dus zhabs pa che chung / te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ phaṃ thing pa sku mched/ mal gyo lo tsā/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa paṇa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ chos rje brag phug pa/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ dpal tshul ba/ ngor chen kun bzang / gu ge paṇa chen/ mkhan chen legs 'byung / rje lha mchog seng ge rje sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong pa bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /sman chen brten pa'i man ngag dang bcas pa bla ma sa chen gyis mdzad pa thos so/ ༈ /bka' gdams gzhung drug las ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ paṇ+ḍi ta bid+dha ka ra pra pa dang / lo tsā ba ban+dhe rin chen mchog gis bsgyur pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom rak+ṣi ta/ dgra bcom pa chos skyob/ dgra bcom pa kriṣ+ṇi'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa/ rgyal rigs thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ar+ya de wa/

'jam dpal grags pa/ rat+na a ka ra shan+ti/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ rdo rje gdan pa bar pa/ rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dpyal chos bzang / dpyal pad+mo can/ mkhan po gzhon nu ye shes/ rong pa sher seng / bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ sprus ston bsod rgyal/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ bla ma chos dpal shes rab/ slob dpon bsod nams seng ge rin po che grags pa don grub/ dgra bcom pa rin chen grags pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rat+na'i mtshan can/ mkhan chen rat+na a ka ra/ rje btsun ngag dbang grags pa/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /byams pa'i smon lam gyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ kun dga' bo/ dge slong ma kun dga' mo/ dge slong ma grags 'dzin ma/ dge slong ma nyer gnas ma/ rnal 'byor pa e ne badz+ra/ rdo rje gdan pa/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ gser gling pa/ jo bo/ 'brom ston pa/ po to ba/ slob dpon byang chub sgang pa/ gces bsgom rdzong pa/ grub thob hūm̐ 'bar/ 'chim nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ skyi ston pa/ dol bu ba/ ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs shes rgyam pa/ rwa ston pa/ rje btsun kun dga' mchog grub/ 'di'i bar du brgyud pa 'ga' zhig btsal/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /byang chub ltung bshags kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ nye bar 'khor/ sha na'i gos can/ nyer sbas/ dhi dhi ka nag po/ legs mthong / phyir mi 'ong / blo mi 'bebs/ yon tan 'od/ shākya 'od/ seng ge'i gdong pa can/ dā na shi la/ dzi na mi tra/ gnyag lo tsā ba/ khyung po grags seng / 'or ston lha'i dbang phyug

so chos shes/ zhang ston dar seng / skyi ston chos mgon dpal/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ chos sku ba/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang / 'jam dbyangs sher rgyam pa/ rwa ston/ rje btsun kun dga' mchog grub/ 'di'i bar du brgyud pa 'ga' zhig btsal/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /shes rab snying po bdud bzlog dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo di paṃ ka ra/ lo tsā ba khu dngos grub/ dhā na shrī/ zla rgyal/ dbang bka' gdams pa/ skyer sgang pa ye shes seng ge sangs rgyas sgom pa/ 'chim nas grub she'i bar sngar bzhin las/ des 'jam dbyangs shes rgyam pa/ rwa ston pa/ rje btsun kun dga' mchog grub/ 'di'i bar du brgyud pa 'ga' zhig btsal/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa/ paṇ+ḍi ta pra dz+nyā warma dang / lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ blo gros brtan pa/ puṇ+ya shrī dha/ gang ba spel/ ga ga na dha ra ya/ gaṅgā dzi na rat+na/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ paṇa chen sardza no/ sa ra he ra baṃ tsa na/ kha bo che/ blo gros grags pa/ mar pa jo 'phan/ 'chim ston don grub/ 'chim ston seng / 'chim nam mkha' grags/ skyi ston shākya 'bum/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bzang po/ rje dpal ldan rdo rje/ rat+na'i mtshan can/ thar lam gsal sgron/ mkhan chen rat+na ā ka ra/ rje btsun ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang po/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/

des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /bslab pa kun las btus kyi lung thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon zhi ba lha/ e la dha ri/ dpa' bo'i sde/ mgon po gser gling pa/ jo bo rje di paṃ ka ra/ 'brom ston pa rin po che/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ chos lung pa gtum ston blo gros grags/ gro mo che ba/ zhang btsun pa/ zhang ston pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ 'chim nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan ral gri/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen dol bu pa/ mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ rtogs ldan ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos rje grags don pa/ chos rje bka' 'gyur ba/ rat+na a ka ra/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags dpal bzang po/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na zhi ba lha/ dze ta ri/ shes rab blo gros 'byung gnas/ dha na shrī/ su ma ti kirti/ rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ khyung rin chen grags/ gnyal pa zhang tshe spong chos kyi bla ma/ nyang phran chos ye/ gtsang nag pa/ rma bya shāka seng / mkhan chen bde ldan pa grub pa dang / mkhan chen rdog ye/ bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje ba/ bla ma chos dpal ba/ chos rje grags don pa/ chos rje bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rat+na'i mtshan can/ mkhan chen rat+na a ka ra/ rje btsun ngag dbang grags pa dpal bzang po/ rje btsun ngag dbang chos grags/ bla ma dpal ldan chos 'byor/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang chos kyi rje de nyid kyi drung du/ rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa'i rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i bka' 'bum pod bzhi mar grags pa'i lung thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa/

shar chen la bstod pa lnga/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ mkhan chen bkra shis rin chen/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ rje sa skya pa chen po rnams la bstod pa/ sdom gsum bla ma brgyud pa la phyag 'tshal ba/ lam zab brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ lam 'bras phyag mchod kyi kha skong / lam 'bras/ bsam mi khyab/ lhan cig skyes grub/ mchod rten drung thob/ yi ge med pa/ pad+ma badz+ra'i lam/ gtum mo lam rdzogs/ yon po bsrang ba/ in+d+ra bhu ti'i lam/ bde mchog rim lnga/ rtsa dbu ma'i ring brgyud/ rtsa dbu ma'i nye brgyud/ bde mchog dkar po/ mahā ma ya'i spros med/ gsang 'dus rim lnga 'gos lugs/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ shin tu spros med/ spyod 'jug zhen pa bzhi bral rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ sher phyin dkar mo/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil chog 'dod rgyal/ tshogs bdag 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil chog gtsug tor rnam rgyal/ nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams la bstod pa/ yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ grub chen bud+dha shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa rnams kyi rnam thar/ gsan yig chen mo/ lam 'bras chos 'byung brtsams 'phro/ bshad thabs gsang ba'i sgo 'byed/ zhus lan gsang ba'i sa bcad/ dbang bzhi'i rtogs bskyed/ mngon rtogs tshul bzhi'i sdom tshig phyi nang gi bskyed rim dbang dang bcas pa'i sdom tshig nang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bir srung bar chad kun sel/ sku'i rnam 'gyur drug gi zin bris/ bir srung thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs bya tshul/ de'i nyams len/ de dang lam 'bras mtshan mtshon sbyar ba/ bir srung gsar ma/ lus dkyil rtsod spong che chung / rgyud gsum gnod 'joms rtsa 'grel/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa mtshams bshad pa/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud kyi byung tshul dang bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ brtag gnyis kyi 'gyur tshad bsab pa sh+lau ka gnyis/

brtag gnyis 'grel pa'i dkar chag kye rdor ḍom+bhi lugs kyi sgrub thabs/ 'phrin yig dbang po'i rdo rje/ gzhal yas khang gi tshad rnam par bzhag pa/ 'phar ma gnyis kyi don bshad pa/ mtsho skyes dang ḍom+bhi'i lugs kyi tho yig sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi bsdus don/ bstod pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa/ mtsho skyes lugs kyi maṇ+ḍal mchod chog bskyed rim gnad kyi zla zer/ gtor chog gi 'grel pa/ 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ gur rigs bsdus kyi sbyin sreg gar gyi shan 'byed/ sangs rgyas kyi gar/ phyogs bzhi gtor ma'i gtang thabs/ chos skyong gi man ngag rnams kyi dkar chag mgon rkyang gi sgrub thabs rgyud 'grel las phyung ba/ lha bdud kyi rjes gnang / gtor chog dgra las rnam rgyal/ gtor sgrub kyi man ngag thugs dam bskang pa'i cho ga kye rdor bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs/ sam+bu ṭi rdo rje dbyings kyi sgrub thabs/ gtor chog mchod phreng / sbyin sreg bkra shis/ tshogs 'khor gsang ba kun rgyan dang tshogs 'khor kun bzang rnam rol/ bde mchog bla ma mchod chog bde mchog gi pho brang gi rnam gzhag ril bu la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub pa/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs dang / bde mchog dkar po'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs cho ga dang bcas pa/ rdo rje lha mo'i tshe sgrub/ la wa pa bcu gsum ma'i mngon rtogs kyi tho/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs kyi tho/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sgrub thabs/ sngags phreng mchan ma/ dkyil chog mchod phreng / gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i sgrub thabs/ shin tu rnal 'byor gyi khyad par/ gtor chog mchod phreng / rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod chog dkyil chog sbyin sreg rab gnas/ bkra shis/ rdo rje phreng ba'i sa bzung gi cho ga
