dgra nag gi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i char 'bebs/ 'jigs byed kyi gtor chog 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ de'i dag pa/ sgrub thabs kyi lung sbyor/ dkyil chog spros med mdzes rgyan/ kun rig dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan phan mtha' yas rdul tshon kha skong / cha gsum gtor ma/ dkyil 'khor sgo sbrags kyi bshad pa/ sbyong rgyud spyi rnam/ bya rgyud spyi rnam/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas gshin po rjes 'dzin/ 'od zer dri med kyi dkyil chog dri med lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang / 'od dpag med kyi tshe sgrub/ seng ge sgra/ sna tshogs yum/ rma bya chen mo/ so so 'brang ma/ 'byung po 'dul byed/ rta mgrin rnams kyi sgrub thabs/ sman bla'i mchod chog sems bskyed rang gis blang ba'i cho ga gso sbyong rang gi blang ba'i cho ga mchod sbyin chen po'i zin bris/ gtor chen gyi lhan thabs/ gser sku rdo rje 'chang bzhengs tshul/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i sngags la zhus dag mdzad pa/ rags sdom bcu'i 'bru 'grel/ bka' 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag mdor bsdus shig rdo rje theg pa'i bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag mtshan nyid bstan 'gyur gyi dkar chag rje btsun gong ma gsum gyi bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag rang gi grwa pa spyi la gdams pa/ sa bzang pa bsod nams dpal/ lo tsā ba rdo rje dpal/ dge 'dun mgon/ a mo gha/ bla chen chos rin pa/ gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon sa bzang / dbu ma pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ mdo stod pa dge bzang rnams kyi dris lan/ sde snod 'dzin pa rat+na shrī la gdams pa/ gsang sngags pa kun dga' gzhon nu la gdams pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gdams pa gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams rin chen la gdams pa sh+lau ka gcig rgya rong pa bkra shis dpal la gdams pa/

sgrub pa po blo bzang la gdams pa gnyis/ nyag ro sangs grags la gdams pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen la springs pa/ bal yul ye rang gi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ma no bo dhi yab sras la springs pa/ dpon po rgyal mtshan dpal yab yum sras bcas la gdams pa/ ya tshe rgyal po hasti rā dza yab yum sras bcas la gdams pa/ de'i slob dpon la gdams pa sh+lau ka gcig a ya dbang phyug bkra shis la gdams pa/ dpon rgan thar pa ye shes la gdams pa/ slob dpon bzod chen la bstod pa/ phyi nang gi yas gtam/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam/ gser 'od dam pa las btus pa'i smon lam/ der ma thus pa chos rje shar pa'i rnam thar/ mngon byang gi bshad pa/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i rnam bshad/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi spyi rnam rtsom 'phro/ kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa/ bka' shog thor bu ba kha yar thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /yang na/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog 'phel/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ dharmā swa mi/ paṇ+ḍe pa ku sa li/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /rong ston chen po shes bya kun rig gis mdzad pa'i chos tshan brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe drug gi nang nas/ gnas brtan chen po nags kyi rin chen la bstod pa/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa/ bla ma bsod nams bzang po la bstod pa/ chos rje blo gros rgya mtsho la bstod pa/ mus pa nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la bstod pa/

nyi ma dpal bzang po la bstod pa/ mkhan chen blo gros gsal ba la bstod pa/ bla ma dam pa gangs pa la bstod pa/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la bstod pa/ mkhan po 'jam dbyangs kha che la bstod pa/ bla ma dam pa sman gong 'du ba la bstod pa/ dam pa ri khrod pa la bstod pa/ mkhas pa dpal chen la bstod pa/ bla ma kun 'dus la bstod pa/ lo chen skyabs mchog la bstod pa/ grub thob chen po brgyad cu la bstod pa/ bir+wa pa la bstod pa/ mkhas pa chen po shan+ti pa la bstod pa/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la bstod pa/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis sa ka'i lha dang bcas pa la bstod pa rin chen spungs pa/ mkhas pa chen po ka ma la shi la la bstod pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng / rje btsun dam pa rgya gar la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs/ grub chen la ba pa la bstod pa byin rlabs kun 'byung / dpal nā ro pa la bstod pa yon tan sgrogs pa'i rnga sgra/ jo bo dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho rnam par rol pa'i bkod pa/ rab sding ma ba la bstod pa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī la bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ bla ma gser gling pa la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi gter mdzod/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la la bstod pa mkhas pa dga' byed/ yang 'dzam gling rgyan drug gi bstod pa thar pa'i them skas/ theg pa chen po dbu ma'i bla ma brgyud rim sogs la bstod pa rin po che'i phreng mdzes/ brgyud pa'i bla ma bod du byon pa rnams kyi bstod pa'i skor la/ lo tsā ba ka cog zhang gsum la bstod pa smra ba'i rgyan/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po la bstod pa rmad byung rgya mtsho'i bkod pa/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab la bstod pa mkhas pa dga' ba'i dbyangs/ jo bo rje'i dngos kyi slob ma khu rngog 'brom gsum la bstod pa dad pa'i snang ba rgyas byed/ jo bo'i brgyud pa'i slob ma po to ba sogs la bstod pa dad pa'i 'od 'phro/

sa chen kun dga' snying po la bstod pa mun pa sel ba'i sgron me/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la bstod pa mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan/ jo bos sa skyar 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun phrag lung bstan pa rnams la bstod pa rin chen phreng ba/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal la bstod pa rmad du byung ba'i 'od phreng / bcom ldan rig ral la bstod pa smra ba'i rgyan/ rgyal sras thogs med pa la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi 'o rgyun/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan la bstod pa rin po che'i me tog kun mkhyen dol po la bstod pa zab don rin chen phreng ba/ kun mkhyen bu ston la bstod pa rab tu snyan pa'i gtam/ kun mkhyen shes rab bzang po la bstod pa ngo mtshar rab rgyas/ mkhas pa chen po gro lung pa dang cha gtsang dan gsum la bstod pa rnam rgyal pad+mo'i phreng ba/ 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs/ thugs dam gyi lha tshogs kyi bstod pa'i skor la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod pa spobs pa mi zad pa'i gter/ yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma la bstod pa yon tan rin po che'i gter mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho rnam par rol pa'i sprin gyi bkod pa/ thub pa'i bstod pa byin rlabs kyi char sprin rnam par g.yo ba/ 'phags pa byams pa la bstod pa mkhas pa dga' ba'i dbyangs/ sangs rgyas klu dbang la bstod pa rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas rab bdun la bstod pa chos kyi rnga sgra/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'chi med rnga sgra la bstod pa 'chi med mdzod/ thugs rje chen po khar+sa pa ṇi la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi char sprin/ tshe dpag med grub pa'i rgyal mo la bstod pa 'chi med rnga sgra/ mkha' 'gro ma rme brtsegs la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi char 'bebs/

mkha' spyod dkar mo la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rnam rol dang / rin chen rgyan phreng gnyis/ mkha' spyod dmar mo la bstod pa snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro nai gu la bstod pa byin rlabs myur mgyogs/ rdo rje phag mo la bstod pa byin rlabs char rgyun/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa la bstod pa byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i gter/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la 'khod pa'i khro bo bcu dang bcas pa la bstod pa rngam pa sgra sgrog gsang ba 'dus pa rigs bzhi'i lha mo rdo rje ma lnga la bstod pa rin chen rgyan gyi phreng ba/ kyai rdo rje la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi char rgyun rnam par g.yo ba/ gshin rje gshed dmar la bstod pa rnam par rol pa'i sgra dbyangs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la bstod pa 'jigs pa'i sgra sgrog 'khor lo bde mchog la bstod pa byin rlabs myur 'jug bde mchog gi 'khor bzhi'i lha tshogs la bstod pa bdud rtsi'i dga' ston/ bde mchog gi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i bstod pa snying po'i mchog 'jam dbyangs smra seng la bstod pa shes rab kyi gter mdzod/ mi g.yo ba la bstod pa spobs pa mi zad pa 'byung ba'i gter/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig la bstod pa ye shes kyi snang ba kun tu rgyas pa/ phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa la bstod pa 'chi med rnga sgra/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu bzang po la bstod pa dga' ba'i me tog kun nas rgyas pa'i phreng ba/ byang sems sgrib pa rnam sel la bstod pa ye shes kyi snang ba kun tu dga' ba'i dbyangs/ sgrol ma u gra ta ra la bstod pa spobs pa mi zad pa'i gter/ nye ba'i sras brgyad la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi chu char g.yo ba'i sprin/ nye ba'i sras mchog zung gcig la bstod pa snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs/ bka' bsdu ba po dgra bcom sogs kyi bstod pa'i skor la dam pa'i chos bsdu ba po rnams la bstod pa phul du byung ba'i yon tan gyi bkod pa/

gnas brtan bcu drug la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rnga sgra/ dgra bcom pa rnams la bstod pa phul du byung ba'i rnga sgra/ phar phyin drug gi yon tan brjod pa tshogs gnyis la spro ba bskyed pa'i gtam/ bslab pa gsum gyi yon tan brjod pa thar pa'i sa 'dzin dag snang rgyas pa 'od kyi phreng ba/ rmad du byung ba'i smon lam gyi gtam/ khrid chen dang / sde snod so so'i brgyud pa la bstod pa'i skor la/ nai gu chos drug gi brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun la bstod pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ nā ro chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa la bstod pa byin rlabs gnad kyi zla zer/ zhi byed brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la bstod pa rmad du byung ba'i phreng ba/ dam chos mngon pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i bstod pa blo gros kyi pad+mo rgyas par byed pa'i nyi ma/ gnas chen rnams kyi bstod pa'i skor la/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan la bstod pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa/ rgya gar gyi shrī na len+d+ra la bstod pa snyan pa'i rnga sgra/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la bstod pa snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs/ dga' ldan gyi lha gnas la bstod pa phul du byung ba'i rnga sgra/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la bstod pa phul du byung ba'i sgra dbyangs/ ri bo gru 'dzin la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi rnga sgra/ bka' srung rnams kyi bstod pa'i skor la/ gur gyi mgon po la bstod pa rngam pa sgra sgrog zhal bzhi pa la bstod pa rmad du byung ba'i sgra sgrog a go ra la bstod pa byin rlabs char 'bebs/ phyag drug pa la bstod pa dngos grub gter mdzod/ dkar mo nyi zla la bstod pa mi 'jigs pa'i gter/ pu tra lcam sring la bstod pa snyan pa'i rnga chen/ bdud rgyal thod phreng la bstod pa mthu stobs skyed byed/ phyag bzhi pa la bstod pa rnam par rgyal ba'i bstod dbyangs/ bsgom rim gyi skor la/ sher phyin nyams su len pa'i man ngag lam lnga gsal sgron/

lam lnga'i khrid yig jo bo'i lugs ting nge 'dzin gyi gol sa'i mtha' dpyad pa'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ blo sbyong spyi dpung don gyi man ngag sku gsung thugs mnyam par gzhag pa'i man ngag rin chen spungs pa dang / sku gsung thugs mnyam par gzhag pa'i man ngag zab don rgya mtsho/ skyabs 'gro'i man ngag gnad kyi zla zer/ sher phyin stong nyid bzhi sbyor nyams su len pa'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i dga' ston/ dbus mtha' rnam par 'byed pa'i bsgom rim snying po rab gsal/ mdo sde rgyan gyi bsgom rim legs bshad sgron me/ rgyud bla'i bsgom rim mi pham dgongs don/ rin chen phreng ba'i bsgom rim rin chen sgron me/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i man ngag gnad kyi snying po/ phar phyin drug nyams su len tshul thar lam bde ba'i 'jug ngogs/ thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba/ dbu ma lta khrid zab don gnad kyi zla zer/ lta khrid kyi bsdus don dbu ma 'jug pa'i bsgom rim rin chen sgron me/ spyod 'jug bsgom rim rin chen rgyan phreng / tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi bsgom rim phul du byung ba'i snying po dang / ngo mtshar snang ba gnyis rnams kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rong ston chen po/ paṇa chen rgya rdor ba/ stong chen shākya'i mtshan can/ stong ra ba kun dga' legs grub/ lum pa ba rje kun dga' chos grags/ rdzong shar ba nam mkha' chos dar/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ /rong ston gyi rnam thar paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan pas mdzad pa'i lung yang thos/ ༈ /chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung 'bum gyi lung thob pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa sgra rgyan me tog dkar po'i phreng ba/ yang de la bstod pa dngos grub kun 'byung /

de la gsol ba 'debs pa bla ma rgyang 'bod/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen la bstod pa dad pa'i pho nya/ de la gsol ba 'debs pa bla ma rgyang 'bod/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub la bstod pa ngo mtshar me tog gi phreng ba/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod pa dad pa'i snye ma/ de la gsol ba 'debs pa bla ma rgyang 'bod/ rtsa ba'i bla ma ngor mus sa gsum la gdung dbyangs kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa snying gi thig le/ yang de gsum la gdung dbyangs kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i gsal 'debs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa la phul ba'i zhu yig bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phul ba'i zhu yig yul khyad par can rnams la mchod brjod kyi tshigs bcad ngag gi 'dod 'jo/ phud mchod dgos 'dod kun 'byung / rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sku'i rnam 'gyur drug la nang gi rnam dag dang mthun par bstod pa/ rdo rje 'chang la snyan ngag 'khor lo'i sgo nas bstod pa bdud rtsi'i 'od can/ ri khrod pa kun dga' mchog ldan la bstod pa byin rlabs myur 'jug rje lha mchog seng ge la bstod pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ mkhas pa lha dbang blo gros la bstod pa rin po che'i mgul rgyan/ dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i pho nya/ de'i kha skong sh+lau ka gcig lam zab brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong / 'khor lo bde mchog gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs/ shin tu spros med kyi brgyud 'debs 'od gsal snye ma/ tshe dpag med kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa/ mgon po'i chos skor gyi brgyud 'debs 'phrin las myur 'grub/ byams pa'i rnam thar bstod pa byams chos kyi lam rim gyi sgo nas 'debs ba 'debs pa dang bcas mi pham dgongs rgyan/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod pa yon tan me tog gi phur ma/

dbyangs can ma la bstod pa don rgyan rnam par bkod pa'i phreng ba/ sgrol ma dkar mo la bstod pa 'chi med rdo rje'i glu dbyangs/ gnyan sgrol dang 'byung 'dul la bstod pa sh+lau ka re re/ rang la bstod pa che chung gsum/ dge sbyong gi chos bzhi bsgrub pa'i dam bca' smon lam du byas pa/ rang la bskul ba theg chen lam gyi gsal 'debs/ rang la gdams pa gces pa drug ldan/ sdom gsum 'gal med du nyams su len tshul ston pa gdams pa sgo drug sa skya pa'i gdung rabs ya rab kyi kha rgyan/ hor gyi rgyal rabs 'phros cung zad dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsis nyung ngu rab gsal/ dus 'khor lugs kyi bstan rtsis mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba'i nyin byed/ sa lo tsā ba chen po'i rnam thar 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi yon tan rnam par bkod pa/ dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i yi ge thub bstan rgyas pa'i nyin byed/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams len gsang ba'i nye lam tshar gsum khug pa/ gsung ngag rin po che'i dmigs rim dang mthun pa'i gsol 'debs zab don snying po/ gsung ngag rin po che'i lam khyer gyi smon lam bdud rtsi'i snying po/ man ngag brda 'grel zab don snang ba/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i gzhung shing la 'phros pa'i dri ba tshigs bcad ma/ tshul dang po gsum gyi don nyung ngu'i ngag gis ston pa tshul gsum gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan/ mngon par rtogs pa'i don nyung ngu'i ngag gis ston pa ljon shing mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ mngon rtogs ljon shing gi gsal byed gong ma'i dgongs rgyan/ bdag med bstod pa'i bsdus don/ rdo rje'i tshigs rkang gi bsdus don tshang bde nyung gsal/ gsung ngag sngon 'gro'i nyams len snang gsum mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ lam gyi dngos gzhi'i khrid yig rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan/ dbang gi sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed/

slob ma rjes gzung gi cho ga kyai rdo rje'i dbang bshad lung ngag gi gter mdzod/ kyai rdo rje'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor lung dang man ngag gi snying po bsdus pa/ sa chog mdor bsdus dbang gi chu bo chen mo mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren pa'i cho ga sgrub thabs bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan/ yan lag drug pa/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi ngag 'don/ lus dkyil mdzes rgyan/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga lag len gsal ba'i me long / de la ltos pa'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi tho yig bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig 'grel pa lugs kyi kyai rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil ḍom+bhi mdzes rgyan/ pad+ma lugs kyi kyai rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil mtsho skyes mdzes rgyan/ nag po lugs kyi sku gsung thugs snying po kyai rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil nag po mdzes rgyan/ yi dam chos skyong gi gtor chog mdzes rgyan/ mgon po'i bsnyen pa byed tshul/ rdo rje gur gyi sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed rab gsal snang ba/ sam+bhu ṭi rdo rje'i dbyings kyi sgrub dkyil kyi gsal byed nyung ngu rab gsal/ bde mchog lū nag gnyis kyi dkyil chog gi gsal byed khyad par bzhi ldan/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig nyams su len tshul/ bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs gtsug gi nor bu'i rgyan/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rin chen sgron ma/ bde mchog dpa' bo drug dpa' mo drug gi sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang bcas pa re re/ rdo rje lha mo'i bzlas sgom la brten nas 'chi med bsgrub pa'i gdams ngag gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub dkyil gyi gsal byed 'chi med bdud rtsi'i snying po/ de'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bklags pa don grub/ dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis/

'jigs byed skyo lugs kyi khrid yig gsung 'gros ma/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba/ de'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rab gnas snang ba/ de'i sgrub thabs dang gtor chog gi gsal byed bsnyen sgrub rnam rol/ rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig nyin byed snang ba/ 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg las gshin bcu gsum ma'i gtor chog rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ kun rig gi dbang gi mtshams sbyor blo gsal kun dga'/ kun rig gi sbyin sreg ro sreg tsha tsha'i rab gnas dang bcas pa/ bya spyod kyi thig tshon gyi byin rlabs/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dkyil chog 'chi med grub pa'i lam bzang / mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil chog las sgrib rnam sbyong / de'i sbyin sreg bum gter gzhug tshul/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i nyin bsrung mtshan bsrung gi byin rlabs kyi tho/ ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang byed tshul/ de'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'dod rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi yig rnying la mchan bu btab pa/ tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len tshul/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i tho yig mun sel sgron me/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs stong mchod rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs/ bum chog rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag med dkar po'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa/ sgrol dkar gyi sgrub thabs de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga gnyan sgrol gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga 'byung 'dul gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga u tsar+ya'i sgrub thabs/

de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga dzam ser nag gi mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa re re/ mi g.yo pa dkar sngon gyi mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa re re/ so 'brang gi sgrub thabs 'chi med rang gzungs zhes bya ba lus bsrung ba'i man ngag gi sgom bzlas/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sgo nas 'chi med sgrub pa'i gdams ngag klu sgrub lugs kyi phyag bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs/ phyag bzhi pa lha mang gi rjes gnang gi cho ga rnam sras kyi gtor chog de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi bslab bya/ yas gtam rin po che'i phreng ba/ bsngo ba'i bstan bcos rin po che'i me tog mkhas pa blo gros bzang po/ bsam yas lha btsun pa/ kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer/ zhu ston bkra shis rgya mtsho/ gnas 'ji chos rje/ bla ma byang chub rgyal mtshan/ bshes gnyen bkra shis dpal ldan/ bshes gnyen tshul khrims dpal bzang / chos rje legs blo ba/ rab 'byams pa 'od blo ba/ chos rje grags pa ba/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ wa skya chos rje/ chos rje bsam 'phel ba/ shi ri chos rje khu dbon gsum/ ri khrod pa sbyin pa 'od zer rnams la bstod pa re re/ kun mkhyen shes rab 'od zer la phul ba me tog gi chun po/ lha btsun ma gur rgyal la phul ba chos gtam bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ mi dbang ngag dbang rnam rgyal la phul ba gzugs kyi me long / de la phul ba'i zhu yig ma mo la spel ba/ sde pa rin chen dbang rgyal la phul ba/ dpal rnam pa lhun grub rtser phul ba gnyis/ shi ri chos rje/ dpon btsun seng ge rgya mtsho/ nang so dpal ldan don grub rnams la gdams pa re re/ 'dzam thang sku skye/ gnas 'ji chos rje/ bla ma byang chub rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bkra shis dpal ldan/ rab 'byams pa shes rab bzang po grogs mched/ glo bo sde pa/ mi chen dpon rnams la phul ba'i zhu yig re re/ ru thog jo bo la phul ba gsum/

dpon chos mdzad la gdams pa/ mngon rtogs ljon shing las 'phros pa'i dris lan nges don gsal ba/ gsang ba sgo 'byed las 'phros pas dris lan zab don snying po/ a ldong bla ma'i dris lan ngang pa'i pho nya/ gnas brtan chos skyong dpal gyi dris lan/ kun gzhi'i skabs kyi dka' gnas gsal byed/ brgal lan tshangs pa'i rigs sngags kyi don bsdus don tshan brgyad pa/ brgal zhing brtags pa'i lan mtha' bral bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho/ mdo khams su 'bul bskul gyi yi ge dkar chag gi yi ge ngo mtshar dpal gyi phreng ba/ rnga bo che la bsngags pa'i rab tu byed pa sogs tshigs bcad thor bu kha yar rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang / rtse gdong bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o/ ༈ /chos kyi rje rgyal tshab dam pa dkon mchog dpal ldan gyi gsung rab kyi lung thob pa la rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi rnam thar 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung gi rnam bshad 'dod dgu'i chu gter blo gsal ngang pa'i bsti gnas/ rdo rje'i tshigs rkang gi bsdus don tshang bde nyung gsal gyi gsal byed rin chen phreng ba/ tshul gsum gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan gyi go don nor bu'i phreng mdzes blo gsal mgul pa'i rgyan/ dpal kye rdo rje'i phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sems 'dzin gyi sngon 'gro rnal 'byor bcu'i nyams len ku mu ta'i ze'u 'bru 'byed pa/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad nges don zla ba'i 'od zer rgyas pa/ 'phags pa zhal bcu gcig pa'i snyung gnas kyi cho ga mun pa gsal byed/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti'i sgrub thabs gtor chog rjes gnang dang bcas pa/ bkra shis kyi rgya mtsho spel ba'i phyir bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rgyal tshab dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub/ des bdag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la'o// //'dir smras pa/ nan+da ad+bhu ta s+ya gu ṇa ni dhi/ kun dga' rmad du byung ba'i yon tan gter/ /sarba pa ri sid+dha r+thadharmā swa mi/ don kun yongs su grub pa chos kyi rje/ /yat+paṃ sa na yā da yu go da la dhe na/ gang khyod rtag tu zhabs zung brtan pa yis/ /shākya s+ya bhan+tu da ya shā sa nā ti/ shākya'i bstan pa shin tu dar gyur cig /bka' gdams bstan pa'i rtsa lag khyed bsngags pas/ /jo bo yab sras sku mched rnam gsum las/ /bstan 'dzin 'phel ltar bdag la'ang rigs brgyud dang / /chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma cher 'phel nas/ /kha ba ri yi 'dzin ma'i khyon 'di kun/ /yongs su khyab ste de dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba kun la bde skyid dpal 'bar te/ /rdzogs ldan bzhin du yun ring spyod gyur cig /chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thob pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba las/ zab rgyas chos kyi rgya mtsho sprul pa'i sku spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub kyis rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te bcu gcig pa'o/ /yang smras pa/ bud+dha trai lokya nā thaṃ su ra na ra na mi taṃ sa ra saṃ sā ra tī raṃ/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po sangs rgyas lha dang mi yi btud pa 'khor ba yi ni pha rol brgal/ /dhi ri gām+bhir+ya ban+taṃ sa ka la gu ṇa ni dhaṃ dharmā ra dz+ya bhi ṣik+ti/ brtan cing zab pa dang ldan mtha' dag yon tan gter gyur chos kyi rgyal srid du ni dbang thob pa/ /triṣ+ṇa mo han+ta kā laṃ ka li ka lu ṣa ha raṃ kā ma lo bhā de brdzadzi taṃ/ sred dang rmongs pa mthar byed rtsod pa'i dus kyi dri ma 'phrog cing 'dod dang chags sogs spangs pa yi/

/ban+daṃ shākya siṃ haṃ pra ṇa ma ti shrī rā sā sarba kā laṃ na mā mi/ btsun pa shākya seng ge de la spyi bos rab tu btud de dus rnams kun tu phyag bgyi'o/ /ya s+ya trī kā la dz+nyā dzi nā nu kam+pa/ gang zhig dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse rnams/ /kū ṭai ka pu ṇ+ya dri sa masta ra siṃ/ mtha' dag gcig spungs bsod nams phung po yis/ /pāk+ṣa di bo dzaṃ ga ma pāṇ+ḍu bhu meḥ ri bo dngos su rgyu 'dra sa skya pa/ /pā dāb+dza tasmai shi rā sā na mā mi/ zhabs kyi chu skyes de la spyi bos 'dud/ /shrī shākya singha s+ya su bhā ṣa sar+tha/ dpal ldan shākya seng ge'i legs bshad kun/ /dz+nyā no mahā bhu ti ba hu shu ta s+ya/ mang thos mkhyen pa'i 'byor pa ches mnga' zhing / /ad+bhu ta a ts+tshin+na karma wa ti/ rmad byung rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phrin las can/ /shrī wan+saṅgu ru s+ya pā da s+ya sin ni dhi/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi drung / /bai ni ya sā ru s+ya ba ra swa hi naṃ/ gdul bya mchog dman rang gi blo 'tshams par/ /dharmā s+ya a mṛ to sā mi ta shak+ṣ+ya an+ta/ chos kyi bdud rtsis nyer bskyangs slob bu'i tha/ /shākya u pā sa ka nan+da pu ṇa ma ma/ shākya'i dge bsnyen kun dga' bsod nams bdag /pra sā da sma re na tsāk+ṣa ba añdza mā ta/ bka' drin dran pas mig zum thal sbyar nas/ /shī gh+ra shī gh+raṃ sa dān+tā sh+tsa/ myur ba myur bar dul ba dang bcas te/ /mu hurmu hurmu mā mi tsa/ yang dang yang du phyag ni 'tshal bar bgyi/ /dzan+ma dzan+ma dā yā gṛh+ṇa/ skye ba skye bar brtse bas rjes 'dzin mdzod/ /ar+tha ar+tha ma bharatra tra taṃ/ don de don du gnyer bya'i gtso bo lags/ /sangs rgyas kun las rgyu mtshan du ma yis/ /bka' drin ches lhag yongs 'dzin mchog rnams las/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul mnos pa rnams/

/snying por dril nas nyams su bla ba'i tshul/ /mdo rgyud lam gyi rim pa dang mthun par/ /rang dang rang gi rjes 'jug slob tshogs dang / /skal mnyam 'gro ba gzhan la'ang phan pa'i phyir/ /nyung ngus ngag gis brjod la bdag yid spro/ /gang du gnas na chos brgyad rnam rtog dang / /phyogs rig chags sdang ngang gis 'phel ba'i gzhi/ /grong khyer tshong 'dus pha yul la sogs pa/ /spangs te dgon gnas ri khrod dben pa bsten/ /der yang chos mthun 'tsho bas chog shes kyis/ /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i blo dor nas/ /blo phugs bla ma dkon mchog la gtad de/ /rang gi sgo gsum bag yod spyod pa'i gnas/ /mi lus thob cing sangs rgyas bstan dang mjal/ /sgo gsum bkol btub rang dbang yod pa yi/ /'di 'dra'i dus su dam chos mi bsgrub na/ /chos byed dus shig nam yang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /dang po mngal du zhugs pa nas brtsams te/ /lo zla zhag dang za mas 'chi bar nye/ /de la bros kyang thar pa'i skabs med na/ /chos med shi na ji 'drar 'gyur snyam bsam/ /tshe 'dir rang gis dge sdig gang bsags pa/ /las de'i dbang gis phyi ma rigs drug lus/ /dbang med blangs nas bde sdug myong 'gyur bas/ /sdig la 'dzems shing dge la 'bad par rigs/ /skye dang rga dang na dang 'chi ba yi/ /chu chen bzhi 'bab las nyon chu srin brgyas/ /gzir ba'i brgal dka' 'khor ba'i mtsho chen las/ /thar thabs chos las med pas de la 'bad/ /bde ba'i skabs bral srid pa'i btson ra 'dir/ /bzod med sdug bsngal gyis gzir sems can rnams/ /tshe sngon phan btags pha mar shes byas nas/ /rgyun chad med par byams dang snying rje bsgom/ /dmigs med snying rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba kun/ /srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs las bskyab pa'i phyir/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod smon pa'i sems/ /kha tsam min pa snying nas yang yang bskyed/ /rgyun chad med par 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyud/

/rang nyid gces 'dzin 'gong po 'di kho na/ /ma gtogs sdug bsngal lan rtsa gzhan med pas/ /bdag 'dzin dgra bo 'dul la 'bad par gces/ /bcos min snying rje chen pos mtshams sbyar nas/ /mkha' khyab 'gro rnams bdag gi mdun dmigs te/ /de dag sdig sdug bdag la len pa dang / /rang gi bde dge 'gro la gtang bar bya/ /de ltar sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po yi/ /nyams len rgyun de rtag tu dran bya zhing / /rang don g.yo sgyu spangs pa'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /dngos brgyud sgo nas gzhan don ci nus bsgrub/ /kun rdzob byang sems nyams len de lta bus/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dgra bo'i mgo mnan nas/ /de nyid drungs nas 'byin phyir don dam gyi/ /byang sems zab mo'i nyams len 'di ltar bya/ /nga 'o snyam pa'i 'dzin stangs de'i gzung byar/ /gyur pa'i bdag de ming lus sems gsum po/ /gang yin ming ni sngon nas med pas na/ /phyis nas btags pa tsam yin lus 'di ni/ /pha ma'i khu khrag las skyes glo bur ba/ /sems ni skye 'gag med pa nam mkha' dang / /rnam dbyer med pas btsal kyang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /des na ming lus sems gsum bdag min yang / /'khrul pas grib ma 'dre ru bzung ba ltar/ /rang gi nyer len phung po la dmigs nas/ /nga med nga dang bdag med bdag bzung ba/ /kho nar shes nas gang zag bdag 'dzin spangs/ /de bzhin 'khor 'das chos kun rmi lam bzhin/ /sems nyid 'khrul snang tsam yin don la med/ /rmi lam 'khrul pa'i phyir na rmi lam nyid/ /rmi ba po yi sems kyang 'khrul snang ste/ /des na gzung 'dzin so sor ma grub pas/ /gnyis stong sems de'ang gzhi rtsa bral bas na/ /gnyis 'dzin gnyis min la sogs mu bzhi yis/ /stong par shes pas chos kyi bdag 'dzin spangs/ /dgag bya mtha' bzhi ma grub de yi phyir/ /de bzhi bkag pa'i dbus kyang mi rnyed pas/ /myong yang brjod mi shes pa'i blo 'das kyi/

/gnas lugs dbyings la gsal bzhag med par bzhag /sems med sems kyis sems la blta shes na/ /mthong med mthong bas sems kyi don mthong 'gyur/ /sgom med bsgom pa'i tshul du bsgom bskyangs pas/ /grol med grol bas sems nyid grol zhes gsungs/ /de ltar thun mong theg pa'i nyams len rnams/ /shes shing sgom pa'i dpyod ldan skyes bu des/ /dbang gis smin nas dam tshig gzhir bzung ste/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lta sgom spyod la bslab/ /tshul der rgya cher bsgrub tshul mtha' yas kyang / /snying po'i nyams len bya tshul 'di lta ste/ /dben zhing nyams dga'i bsam gtan spyil bu ru/ /chos mthun stan la sgo gsum cha mnyam ste/ /nam yang bslu med dkon mchog rnam bzhi la/ /dad shugs drag pos snying nas skyabs 'gro zhing / /mkha' khyab 'gro la dmigs pa'i snying rje yis/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bya/ /drin can bla ma spyi bor rtag bsgom la/ /khyed shes khyed mkhyen tshul gyi gsol ba btab/ /mnyam rjes kun tu snang grags rig gsum 'di/ /lha sngags ye shes rol par dran byas la/ /bdag med gnyis kyis stong pa'i rang gi sems/ /rang rig rang gsal gnyug ma'i rang zhal blta/ /bltas pas ma mthong gsal stong 'gag med dang / /rtog med mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rjer bzhag /yid la byar med sgom gyi mchog yin par/ /gsungs pas gzung bya dang ni 'dzin byed dang / /bsgom bya sgom byed yod med yin min sogs/ /'phro 'du kun spangs mnyam nyid chen por bzhag /shes pa bying na skyabs 'gro gsol gdab 'bad/ /rgod na thar med 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam/ /yang na rnam rtog thol skyes rbad bcad de/ /bying rgod med par dbyings rig bsres la bzhag /phyogs ris med pa'i rang sems gsal stong gi /chos sku rang la yod kyang ma shes pas/ /thag khra sbrul du 'khrul ltar bdag 'dzin gyis/ /bcings pa'i 'gro la bzod med snying rje bsgom/

/de ltar rang gi dge ba ci bsags pa/ /sems can don du byang chub sar bsngos la/ /spyod lam thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam ltar/ /dran pas bstan 'gro'i don mang ci nus bsgrub/ /mdor na dus rnams kun tu ma brtags pa'i/ /spyod pa spangs nas brtson ldan dran shes dang / /bag yod blo yis thabs shes zung 'brel gyi/ /lam 'di bsgrubs na byang chub myur thob 'gyur/ /da dung gces pa'i gdams ngag cung zad bshad/ /chags pa skye ba'i yul la zhen pa spangs/ /zhe sdang skye ba'i yul la byams pa sgoms/ /gti mug skye ba'i yul la rtog dpyod thongs/ /nad dang sdug bsngal gang byung lam du khyer/ /gdon bgegs lhar sgoms de la dngos grub longs/ /de tsam ma nus phan sems snying rje skyed/ /mi rtag dran pas yang yang lcag gis skul/ /phyi rol snang ba'i yul la zhen pa thongs/ /nang du rang sems 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba chod/ /bar du rnam smin lus kyi gces 'dzin bshig /srid pa hrul por gtong ba'i thabs mchog lags/ /skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ /zab rgyas chos tshul mnos pa'i snying po'i don/ /nyams su len tshul mdo rgyud dgongs pa bzhin/ /bshad pa 'di la dpyod ldan kun dges mdzod/ /khungs dang 'brel ba'i zab chos mtha' yas pa/ /thos tshul bstan bcos rta ljang 'di shar bas/ /dam chos rin chen gter mang gsal mthong phyir/ /zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed yin/ /'di sbyar dge bas rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rab rdzogs nas/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag gzhan 'gro ba'i sgrib kun byang gyur cig /de la brten nas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin cing lus brtas dbang po gsal/ /bstan pa'i bya ba ma lus mthar phyin te/ /sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas byed shog /deng sang dus kyi skal bzang las 'phro can/ /dad brtson shes rab snying rje ldan pa yis/

/bstan pa 'dzin nus gang zag thams cad kyang / /zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor du 'du bar shog /dad pa dman zhing dge ba'i blo gros dman/ /chos la 'jug pa'i skal ba dman rnams kyang / /bdag gi thabs mkhas 'phrin las sna tshogs kyis/ /kun kyang dbang 'dus dge la sbyor bar shog /ma dad mi bsrun bstan dang 'gro la gnod/ /zhi bas mi thul rnams kyang bdag cag gis/ /ma bcol na yang bka' srung dam can gyis/ /tshar bcad rnam shes chos dbyings sgrol bar shog /mdor na bdag dang bdag gi slob bu'i tshogs/ /kun gyi sgo gsum bya ba spyod lam rnams/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i rgyur gyur nas/ /kun kyang bde skyid dpal la spyod par shog /phyi ma dpon slob lhan cig dag pa'i zhing / /bde ba can du skyes nas rang don rnams/ /mthar phyin gang 'dul sprul pas srid mtha'i bar/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rgyas byed shog /ces chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar thos pa'i tshul legs par bshad pa zab rgyas chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ srid gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam par sprul pa yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' dang dbyer ma mchis pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po rje btsun rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ zab yangs chos kyi spyan ldan sprul pa'i sku rgyal ba'i sras po spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i gter chen nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi sdom rgyun 'dzin pa sha chang zhal la mi reg pa sogs sku btsun pa'i mthar thug pas gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la thugs brtan pa chos kyi rje nags dgon pa sbyin pa grags pa/

mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya'i gnas thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes shing / nang du yang dag pa'i zab bzhes kyi ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor bas snyigs dus kyi yongs 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan gcig pu thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen mkhan chen ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa la sogs te yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan gyi dam pa mang po'i bka' drin gyis nye bar bskyangs shing thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung ba'i skal ba bzang po can/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug la sogs te rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams la phan par bsams nas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig so so la gzhi byas/ cung zad mi mthun pa dang the tshom gyi gzhir gyur pa rnams bla ma so so'i rnam thar dang / chos 'byung lo rgyus la sogs pa shes byed kyi khungs rnam par dag pa la gtugs te/ rang gi bgrang gzhi bcu phrag bzhi dang nyag ma brgyad du slebs pa/ 'phags pa'i yul na tā ra ṇaḥzhes pa sgrol byed ces grags shing / rgya nag lugs la shing pho spre'u'i lo chu stod zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes bcu bzhi sngon gyi skyes chen 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang / dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po yab sras sogs dang / phyi rabs bstan pa'i gsal byed dam pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po la sogs te/ sprul pa'i sku du ma zab mo chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul bstan pa'i zla dus kyi dus bzang khyad par can gyi nyin gong ma 'brel tshad don ldan de dag gi dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshe/ chos grwa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi tshoms dmar du/ sa gsum gyi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri pad+ma can gyi drung ga la ba der legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros rab tu gsal bas/

spyir gsung rab mang po la rnam dpyod kyi snang ba ches cher rgyas shing / khyad par gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang / yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa gdong dga' ba bsam pa don chen gyis gus spro'i sgo nas brtson 'grus chen pos bgyis pa re zhig rdzogs so/ /karma bistar bha wa tu/ 'phrin las rgyas par gyur cig swāsti dza yan+tu/ dge legs rgyas par gyur cig oṃ swāsti shrī dza yan+tu/ dpal bkra shis dge legs rgyas par gyur cig /shu bha mastu sarba dza ga tāṃ/ dge bar gyur cig 'gro ba thams cad rnams/ /swāsti pra dza bh+yaḥ dge bar gyur cig skye dgu rnams la'o// maṅga laṃ// bkra shis/ //gcig zhus// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ bla ma dam pa rnams la bstod pa pad+marāga'i phreng ba zhes bya ba sde tshan grangs 1 nas 34bar / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
